items.topic_zh: Alexandrov 空间的分布曲率刻画
items.explanation_zh: 用弱曲率条件识别具有下曲率界的度量空间。
items.source_title: Gigli’s distributional curvature characterization of Alexandrov spaces
items.source_abstract: For every integer n ≥ 2 and κ ∈ ℝ, we prove that a complete separable metric space is an n-dimensional Alexandrov space of curvature at least κ if and only if, with reference measure $`\mathcal H^n`$, it is a full-support $`\mathrm{RCD}((n-1)\kappa,n)`$ space whose distributional sectional curvature is at least κ in Gigli's original global test classes. This resolves Gigli's characterization conjecture in dimensions at least two.

items.source_title: Global Arthur Enhancements of Cuspidal Excursion Parameters
items.source_abstract: Under the finite-level Ramanujan–Arthur decomposition stated in Theorem 1.1, we construct a global Arthur enhancement for every occurring cuspidal excursion parameter at a specified full finite level for a split connected semisimple group over a global function field. A single algebraic SL2 and a commuting Weil centralizer map recover the given parameter by diagonal specialization on the entire Weil group, including inertia. The result does not assert ellipticity, Arthur-packet classification, or a multiplicity formula.

items.source_abstract: We prove the Global Spherical Shell conjecture: every connected minimal compact complex surface of class VII with positive second Betti number contains a global spherical shell. This is a holomorphically embedded neighborhood of the standard three-sphere in $`\mathbb C^2\setminus\{0\}`$ whose complement is connected.

items.topic_zh: 弱 MTW 条件下的全局支撑

items.source_abstract: We prove that weak Ma–Trudinger–Wang curvature on a smooth, connected, compact Riemannian manifold of dimension at least two without boundary implies convexity of every tangent injectivity domain, resolving Villani's conjecture in this setting. Conjugate cut points are allowed. More generally, every ordinary subgradient of a squared-distance cost potential is a minimizing velocity with a global supporting mountain. No density hypothesis is used.

This resolves the smooth three-dimensional isotropic elastic Calderón uniqueness problem under these positivity assumptions.

items.source_title: Global classical solutions of the three-dimensional relativistic Vlasov–Maxwell system
items.source_abstract: We prove global existence and uniqueness for arbitrary smooth admissible initial data in the three-dimensional, one-species relativistic Vlasov–Maxwell system. The particle density is initially compactly supported, and the electromagnetic fields have finite energy and bounded derivatives of all orders. The solution remains smooth on every finite time interval. This resolves the large-data global classical regularity problem for this model, without size or symmetry restrictions on the data.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 无理层级的量子几何 Langlands
items.explanation_zh: 研究无分歧量子几何对应中的范畴等价。
items.source_title: Global quantum geometric Langlands at irrational level
items.source_abstract: We prove the unramified quantum geometric Langlands equivalence for every connected simple complex algebraic group G and every level $`c\in\mathbb C\setminus\mathbb Q`$, including non-real levels. For every smooth projective connected complex curve X, it identifies the full twisted D-module categories on $`\mathop{\mathrm{Bun}}\nolimits _G(X)`$ and $`\mathop{\mathrm{Bun}}\nolimits _{G^\vee}(X)`$ at the dual shifted levels c and $`-1/(rc)`$, where r is the lacing number. The equivalence uses the given global forms and includes all connected components.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 椭圆曲线扭转的秩分布
items.explanation_zh: 研究 Goldfeld 密度猜想与二次扭转。
items.source_title: Goldfeld's analytic density conjecture and the 2-converse for elliptic curves
items.source_abstract: We prove Goldfeld's analytic density conjecture: for every elliptic curve E over ℚ, the quadratic twists of E with analytic rank zero and one each have density 1/2 among signed squarefree twist parameters ordered by absolute value. We also prove the low-corank 2-converse: if the $`2^\infty`$-Selmer corank of E is zero or one, then it equals the analytic and Mordell–Weil ranks, and the Tate–Shafarevich group is finite.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 图的整数期望阈值分解
items.explanation_zh: 研究图分割与组合期望阈值的关系。
items.source_title: Graph Decompositions at the Integral Expectation Threshold
items.source_abstract: We prove the graph-decomposition conjecture of Ascoli, He, Park, and Talagrand. Every graph admits a partition into a universally bounded number of fixed edge pieces, each having ordinary containment threshold at most a universal constant times the original graph's integral expectation threshold. The partition is chosen before sampling the random host, and the separate embeddings of the pieces need not agree on shared vertices.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 稀薄硬球气体的基态凝聚
items.explanation_zh: 研究三维玻色硬球基态的宏观占据。
items.source_title: Ground-state condensation in the dilute hard-sphere gas
items.source_abstract: We prove Bose–Einstein condensation in every ground state of a dilute three-dimensional hard-sphere Bose gas. At every sufficiently small fixed gas parameter, the constant orbital contains a positive fraction of the particles in the thermodynamic limit. The fraction can be chosen independently of the gas parameter, and the conclusion holds for arbitrary complex ground states.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 低于稳定 Morse 数的不动点
items.explanation_zh: 构造 Hamilton 变换，检验预期不动点下界。
items.source_title: Hamiltonian Fixed Points Below the Stable Morse Number
items.source_abstract: We disprove the stable Morse lower bound for nondegenerate Hamiltonian fixed points by constructing a simply connected closed Kähler manifold with sixteen fewer fixed points than its stable Morse number. All the corresponding periodic orbits are contractible. The construction combines a Hamiltonian involution with integral homology torsion at two different primes; its proof uses finite-dimensional Morse theory and complex blowups.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 二十二维的不动点反例
items.explanation_zh: 在固定二十二维中研究稳定 Morse 下界。
items.source_title: Hamiltonian Fixed Points Below the Stable Morse Number in Dimension Twenty-Two
items.source_abstract: We disprove the stable Morse lower bound for nondegenerate Hamiltonian fixed points with examples in fixed real dimension twenty-two. For every integer m ≥ 1, we construct a simply connected closed Kähler manifold with stable Morse number $`80+1968m`$ and a Hamiltonian diffeomorphism with exactly $`80+1952m`$ fixed points, all nondegenerate and with contractible orbit loops. The deficit is therefore unbounded, and the fixed-point count is at most 127/128 of the stable Morse number.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 硬球体系的涨落
items.explanation_zh: 研究非平衡 Boltzmann 时间范围内的中心极限。
items.source_title: Hard-sphere fluctuations on the regular Boltzmann lifespan
items.source_abstract: We prove a finite-dimensional central limit theorem away from equilibrium for a deterministic grand-canonical hard-sphere gas in three dimensions. The initial probability density is smooth, with spatially summable Gaussian velocity bounds on the density and its spatial gradient. The limit holds on every finite interval on which the classical Boltzmann solution has uniform Gaussian velocity decay. The empirical measure is centered by its exact microscopic expectation. Its fluctuations converge to the Gaussian solution of the linear fluctuating Boltzmann equation.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 三色图大独立集的计算难度
items.explanation_zh: 研究容易着色的图中寻找大独立集的困难。
items.source_title: Hardness of finding large independent sets in three-colorable graphs
items.source_abstract: We prove that, for every fixed $`0\lt \delta\lt 1/3`$, it is NP-hard to distinguish three-colorable graphs from graphs in which every independent set has fewer than δ times the number of vertices. Consequently, for every fixed integer c ≥ 3, finding a proper c-coloring of a three-colorable graph is NP-hard.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Artin 群的 K(π,1) 猜想
items.explanation_zh: 研究 Salvetti 复形是否为无高阶同伦空间。
items.source_title: Harmonic heights and the Artin K(pi,1) conjecture
items.source_abstract: We prove that the standard Salvetti complex of every Artin group with finitely many standard generators is aspherical. This resolves the Artin $`K(\pi,1)`$ conjecture in finite rank.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 任意偏置布尔函数的 Hellinger 收缩
items.explanation_zh: 研究信息距离经过布尔输出后如何衰减。
items.source_title: Hellinger contraction with arbitrary Boolean output bias
items.source_abstract: We prove the Hellinger conjecture for Boolean functions on the uniform discrete cube, with arbitrary output bias. For a Boolean function of mean m and every $`\rho\in[-1,1]`$, the loss $`\sqrt{1-m^2}-\mathbb E\sqrt{1-(T_\rho f)^2}`$ is at most $`1-\sqrt{1-\rho^2}`$, with equality for signed coordinates. The proof combines asymmetric dimension induction, a calibrated noise-semigroup energy estimate, and finite exact arithmetic certificates. The Hellinger inequality also yields the Courtade–Kumar information bound.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 有理数上的 Hilbert 第十问题
items.explanation_zh: 研究算法能否判定多项式有无有理解。
items.source_title: Hilbert’s tenth problem over the rational numbers
items.source_abstract: We give a negative answer to Hilbert's tenth problem over the rational numbers: no algorithm decides whether a polynomial with integer coefficients has a rational zero. The number of variables is part of the input.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 五层矩阵乘积电路的下界
items.explanation_zh: 估计齐次算术电路计算连续矩阵乘积的规模。
items.source_title: Homogeneous depth-five lower bounds for iterated matrix multiplication
items.source_abstract: Let $`\mathop{\mathrm{IMM}}\nolimits _{n,n}`$ be the $`(1,1)`$ entry of a product of n independent $`n\times n`$ matrices of variables. Over every field of characteristic zero, every syntactically homogeneous $`\Sigma\Pi\Sigma\Pi\Sigma`$ circuit computing $`\mathop{\mathrm{IMM}}\nolimits _{n,n}`$ has at least $`n^{\sqrt n/400}`$ gates for all sufficiently large n, with an absolute threshold independent of the field. Bottom linear forms may have arbitrary support, and arbitrary finite fan-in, fan-out, and gate sharing are allowed. Over every field, a block expansion gives such circuits with at most $`n^{\sqrt n+4}`$ gates for n ≥ 2. Thus the gate complexity over characteristic-zero fields is $`n^{\Theta(\sqrt n)}`$.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 没有半正定提升的双曲锥
items.explanation_zh: 研究增加变量是否总能实现矩阵表示。
items.source_title: Hyperbolicity Cones Without Semidefinite Lifts
items.source_abstract: We prove that not every hyperbolicity cone is a spectrahedral shadow: some closed hyperbolicity cones admit no finite affine semidefinite lift, even with arbitrary real coefficients and any finite number of auxiliary variables. This disproves the Projected Lax Conjecture and hence the generalized Lax conjecture.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 不可压缩流中的箱体输运
items.explanation_zh: 用保体积流体实现有限仿射计算。
items.source_title: Incompressible Box Transport and Finite Computation
items.source_abstract: We realize finite positive diagonal affine maps of determinant one by effective smooth incompressible flows on neighborhoods of entire closed rational solid boxes. The source and target families are each disjoint, but may overlap each other. The construction uses localized curls, evacuation to storage and obstacle detours. A balanced three-stack recorder then assigns every machine and finite input a smooth Navier–Stokes force with one compact spatial support, periodic after a loading interval, at any fixed positive computable viscosity. The fluid starts at rest, and one fixed particle enters one fixed open cube exactly when the machine halts. Further constructions give fixed torus charts, periodicity from time zero, alternative history guards and bounded or slab observers. Onto slow clocks yield separate decaying forces. Each construction includes an all-time observation proof, effective derivative bounds and a stated pressure comparison class.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: L¹ 独立乘积与中点凸性
items.explanation_zh: 研究渐近中点凸性与可重赋范性的差别。
items.source_title: Independent products in real L1: asymptotic midpoint convexity without AUC renormings
items.source_abstract: For a countably branching tree, the closed real L1 spans of products of independent exponential or Gaussian-square multipliers along its paths have positive averaged asymptotic midpoint moduli and admit no equivalent asymptotically uniformly convex norm. The renorming obstruction holds for every positive nonconstant mean-one multiplier with finite second moment.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 球面上的无限闭测地线
items.explanation_zh: 研究任意光滑球面度量中的闭合最短路径。
items.source_title: Infinitely many closed geodesic images on every Riemannian sphere
items.source_abstract: We resolve the sphere case of the closed-geodesic infinitude problem: every smooth Riemannian metric on the standard sphere Sn, n ≥ 2, has infinitely many prime closed geodesics with pairwise distinct images. The two-sphere case is classical; the result in higher dimensions includes degenerate metrics. Using finite covers and theorems of Perelman and Rademacher–Taimanov, we also obtain the same conclusion for every smooth Riemannian metric on a nonempty closed smooth three-manifold.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 低于 n log n 的整数乘法
items.explanation_zh: 改进两个 n 位整数相乘的最坏时间复杂度。
items.source_title: Integer multiplication below n log n
items.source_abstract: We give a deterministic algorithm that multiplies two n-bit integers in $`O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})`$ worst-case time, with $`\kappa=2^{-182}`$, on one fixed finite-alphabet Turing machine with a fixed finite number of one-dimensional tapes. The algorithm is exact for every input length and disproves the $`n\log n`$ optimality conjecture of Schönhage and Strassen in this model.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 有理连通空间的分裂切丛
items.explanation_zh: 研究全纯切丛分解的两部分是否可积。
items.source_title: Integrability of split tangent bundles on rationally connected manifolds
items.source_abstract: We prove that both summands of every specified holomorphic splitting of the tangent bundle of a smooth rationally connected projective complex manifold into two positive-rank subbundles are integrable. This proves Höring's conjecture on rationally connected projective manifolds. Höring's product theorem then gives a product decomposition compatible with the specified splitting.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 可积度量与受控边界
items.explanation_zh: 研究带边界反典范度量何时产生有效除子。
items.source_title: Integrable metrics and effectivity with controlled boundary
items.source_abstract: Let Y be smooth projective and let C be an effective integral divisor. If $`-K_Y+C`$ admits a metric with a global strict curvature lower bound for which the canonical section of C is locally square integrable, every pseudoeffective rational divisor becomes rationally effective after an effective correction supported on C. For a smooth projective X with smoothly semipositive $`L=-K_X`$, sections of $`m_jL-P`$ at unbounded positive exponents, with any fixed pseudoeffective Cartier error P, yield a section of a positive multiple of L.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Witt 向量上的 Donovan 有限性
items.explanation_zh: 研究有限群代数块的整数等价类型。
items.source_title: Integral Donovan Finiteness over Witt Vectors
items.source_abstract: We prove integral Donovan finiteness: for every prime p and positive integer M, the blocks of all finite groups with defect groups of order at most M have only finitely many Morita equivalence classes over $`W(\overline{\mathbb F}_p)`$. The defect groups need not be abelian, and the result includes p = 2. The same bounded-defect finiteness holds over each fixed complete discrete valuation ring of characteristic zero with algebraically closed residue field of characteristic p, including ramified rings.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 整数与分数期望阈值
items.explanation_zh: 比较两种组合期望阈值是否只差统一常数。
items.source_title: Integral and fractional expectation thresholds are equivalent
items.source_abstract: We prove Talagrand's conjecture that integral and fractional expectation thresholds are within a universal constant factor, with the same covering budget.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 曲线特征簇上的整点
items.explanation_zh: 研究 SL 表示空间中整点的代数稠密性。
items.source_title: Integral points on character varieties of curves
items.source_abstract: We prove potential Zariski density of integral points on SLr-character varieties of smooth complex curves in every rank. The result allows prescribed quasi-unipotent boundary monodromy, including exact nonsemisimple conjugacy classes, and holds on every component over the full ring of integers of one finite extension. Here integrality is measured in the ambient character variety, while the exact boundary conditions are imposed on the complex representation.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 平面 Mumford–Shah 极小解
items.explanation_zh: 研究图像分割能量的内部光滑性与裂纹结构。
items.source_title: Interior regularity of planar Mumford–Shah minimizers
items.source_abstract: We prove the interior regularity assertion of the planar Mumford–Shah conjecture for reduced absolute minimizers with bounded fidelity data. Every interior point of the closed discontinuity set has a neighborhood consisting of a $`C^{1,\alpha}`$ arc, an arc ending at that point, or three such arcs meeting at 120 degrees. Only finitely many global connected components meet any relatively compact open set.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 不变反典范指数
items.explanation_zh: 研究紧环面作用下扭曲微分形式的转换。
items.source_title: Invariant anticanonical indices and conversion of twisted differentials
items.source_abstract: For a holomorphic action of a compact torus on a compact complex manifold, we prove that the invariant Euler characteristic of naturally linearized anticanonical powers is polynomial on a divisible progression, with its actual value at exponent zero. Independently, on a smooth projective variety with smoothly semipositive anticanonical bundle, we remove a fixed pseudoeffective error from an unbounded sequence of effective twists. These results convert invariant cohomology into twisted differential forms and prove anticanonical nonvanishing on smooth projective varieties with smoothly semipositive anticanonical bundle, by descending the forms before conversion.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 无理旋转的不变投影反例
items.explanation_zh: 研究圆周权重与指定投影结构的障碍。
items.source_title: Invariant-projection counterexamples for every irrational rotation
items.source_abstract: For every irrational angle, we construct a continuous nonnegative circle weight with exactly one zero and logarithmic integral $`-\infty`$ whose weighted rotation has no nontrivial invariant projection in the associated hyperfinite type II1 factor. This answers negatively the question of Zhu, Fang, and Shi, with the angle prescribed in advance. The resulting operator is nonzero and norm-quasinilpotent.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 具有 K3 范畴的无理三次四维簇
items.explanation_zh: 研究几何 K3 范畴与四维簇的有理性。
items.source_title: Irrational cubic fourfolds with geometric K3 categories
items.source_abstract: For every sufficiently large admissible Hassett discriminant, we prove that a very general cubic fourfold of that discriminant is irrational, although its Kuznetsov component is equivalent to the ordinary derived category of a projective K3 surface. The discriminant threshold is ineffective. This disproves Kuznetsov's rationality conjecture. The same cubics have associated untwisted polarized K3 surfaces in the Hodge-theoretic sense, so they also disprove the sufficiency direction of the associated-K3 rationality prediction.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Kadison 相似性问题
items.explanation_zh: 用统一导子估计研究代数同态的相似变换。
items.source_title: Kadison's similarity theorem through uniform derivation estimates
items.source_abstract: We prove that every bounded complex-linear unital algebra homomorphism from a unital complex C∗-algebra into the bounded operators on an arbitrary Hilbert space is similar to a $`*`$-homomorphism. This resolves Kadison's similarity conjecture positively. We also obtain one universal hyperreflexivity constant for all unital von Neumann algebras on arbitrary complex Hilbert spaces.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Koebe 圆域猜想
items.explanation_zh: 研究任意球面区域能否共形等价于圆域。
items.source_title: Koebe's Circle-Domain Conjecture
items.source_abstract: We prove that every domain in the Riemann sphere is conformally equivalent to a circle domain, resolving Koebe's circle-domain conjecture positively.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 有界树宽图的 L¹ 嵌入
items.explanation_zh: 估计图最短路距离嵌入向量空间的扭曲。
items.source_title: L1 Embeddings of Graphs of Bounded Treewidth
items.source_abstract: For every fixed treewidth bound, the shortest-path metrics of finite connected graphs with arbitrary positive real edge lengths embed into real L1 with uniformly bounded distortion. This resolves the bounded-treewidth case of the Gupta–Newman–Rabinovich–Sinclair conjecture positively.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Lech 重数猜想
items.explanation_zh: 研究平坦局部环映射下的重数变化。
items.source_title: Lech's multiplicity conjecture
items.source_abstract: We prove Lech's multiplicity conjecture: Hilbert–Samuel multiplicity cannot decrease under a flat local homomorphism of nonzero Noetherian local rings. The result holds in arbitrary dimension, with no restrictions on the residue fields or characteristics.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 从支撑提升代数截面
items.explanation_zh: 研究伴随除子截面从约化支撑到整体的提升。
items.source_title: Lifting sections from the reduced support of an adjoint
items.source_abstract: For a projective ℚ-factorial dlt pair with effective rational boundary over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, we prove that the adjoint has positive Iitaka dimension whenever a nonzero effective Cartier multiple is supported on the coefficient-one boundary and restricts to a semiample line bundle on its whole reduced support. This gives log abundance after nonvanishing in dimension at most four over ℂ.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 随机 3-SAT 停时的线性方差
items.explanation_zh: 计算公式首次失去可满足性时刻的涨落。
items.source_title: Linear Variance of the Random 3-SAT Hitting Time
items.source_abstract: For random 3-SAT on n Boolean variables, with independent uniformly signed clauses on three distinct variables sampled with replacement, we prove that the first unsatisfiable prefix has variance $`\Theta(n)`$. The upper bound removes the logarithmic loss in the earlier variance estimate; the matching lower bound follows from Wilson's transition-width theorem.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 距离等价却不线性同构的空间
items.explanation_zh: 比较 Banach 空间的非线性距离与线性结构。
items.source_title: Lipschitz Equivalent Separable Banach Spaces Need Not Be Linearly Isomorphic
items.source_abstract: There are separable real Banach spaces that are globally bi-Lipschitz equivalent but not linearly isomorphic. This gives a negative answer to the separable Banach-space Lipschitz-isomorphism problem.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 精确高斯观测的信息增长
items.explanation_zh: 研究有限消息的定位代价与信息恢复。
items.source_title: Localization costs and information growth for exact Gaussian observations
items.source_abstract: For the image of a uniform cube under a spherical coordinate map, we prove that finite messages from t blocks of $`\Theta(d)`$ exact Gaussian measurements reveal only $`O_A(dt)`$ information when each message has at most $`\exp(Ad^2)`$ values, for fixed A. The same bound holds when each message is supplemented with a nested cell that restores the required geometric spread.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 条件化 Kähler 对数丰沛性
items.explanation_zh: 在对数 Iitaka 次可加性前提下研究丰沛性。
items.source_title: Log abundance for compact Kähler spaces under logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity
items.source_abstract: Assume logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity for surjective morphisms with connected fibers between smooth projective complex varieties with compatible reduced simple normal crossing boundaries. We prove log abundance for normal irreducible compact Kähler spaces in every dimension: for a log canonical pair $`(X,\Delta)`$ with effective rational boundary and $`K_X+\Delta`$ ℚ-Cartier, analytic nefness of $`K_X+\Delta`$ implies semiampleness.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 特征零的对数丰沛性
items.explanation_zh: 研究任意维数中伴随除子的半丰沛性。
items.source_title: Log abundance in characteristic zero
items.source_abstract: We prove the rational-boundary log abundance conjecture in every dimension over algebraically closed fields of characteristic zero: every nef ℚ-Cartier log canonical divisor on a projective log canonical pair with effective rational boundary is semiample. Over ℂ, the proof also establishes canonical nonvanishing for smooth projective varieties in every dimension.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 正特征三维的对数丰沛性
items.explanation_zh: 研究数值维数为一时的伴随除子。
items.source_title: Log abundance in numerical dimension one for threefolds in positive characteristic
items.source_abstract: We prove the numerical-dimension-one case of log abundance for threefolds over algebraically closed fields of characteristic p > 3. If $`(X,B)`$ is a projective log canonical threefold pair with effective rational boundary, and $`K_X+B`$ is ℚ-Cartier, nef, and of numerical dimension one, then $`K_X+B`$ is semiample. Neither terminality nor ℚ-factoriality of X is required.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 对数 Kodaira 维数与纤维变化
items.explanation_zh: 比较整体、底空间和纤维的几何复杂度。
items.source_title: Logarithmic Kodaira dimension and whole-fiber variation
items.source_abstract: We prove the logarithmic Iitaka–Viehweg inequality for projective surjective morphisms with connected fibers between smooth complex quasi-projective varieties whose base has nonnegative logarithmic Kodaira dimension. The variation measures the birational field of definition of the whole geometric generic fiber. This resolves Popa's logarithmic variation conjecture positively.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 弱无序 Ising 模型的对数涨落
items.explanation_zh: 在指定参考估计下控制相对二阶矩。
items.source_title: Logarithmic Relative Fluctuations in the Weakly Disordered Planar Ising Model
items.source_abstract: Assuming the stated deterministic critical-reference estimates, we prove that the relative second moment of the quenched critical spin correlation in the square-lattice Ising model with independent fair bonds $`1\pm\varepsilon`$ grows as $`(\log r)^{1/4+o(1)}`$ for each sufficiently small fixed ε > 0. The correlation is evaluated at the physical critical temperature, with the thermodynamic limit taken before the disorder moments and the large-distance limit.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 带标记多边形的关联
items.explanation_zh: 研究临界蜂窝模型中多边形质量与单弧界。
items.source_title: Marked polygon correlations and one-arc bounds
items.source_abstract: At the critical honeycomb vertex activity, the squared-length mass of simple polygons of diameter at most H, counted modulo translations, is at most $`H^{2/3+o(1)}`$. We also prove a quantitative two-mark cylinder estimate and a polynomial one-arc bound uniform even for arbitrarily unequal marked intervals.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 固定长度蜂窝路径的覆盖指数
items.explanation_zh: 估计自回避路径的质量与空间覆盖尺度。
items.source_title: Mass and covering exponents for fixed-length honeycomb walks
items.source_abstract: For uniform self-avoiding walks of every sufficiently large integer length on the honeycomb lattice, we prove diameter exponent 3/4 and simultaneous local-mass and covering exponent 4/3, with arbitrary positive exponent slack and arbitrary polynomial failure probability.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 矩阵乘法指数的 9/4 上界
items.explanation_zh: 研究复矩阵乘法的渐近运算复杂度。
items.source_title: An Upper Bound of 9/4 for the Matrix Multiplication Exponent
items.source_abstract: We prove that the exponent of matrix multiplication over the complex numbers is at most 9/4.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 高维多点 Seshadri 常数
items.explanation_zh: 研究线丛在多个点处的局部正性。
items.source_title: Maximal Multipoint Seshadri Constants in Higher Dimensions
items.source_abstract: Let L be an ample line bundle on a smooth integral complex projective variety X of dimension n ≥ 3. We prove that there is a threshold $`r_0=r_0(X,L)`$ such that for every integer $`r\ge r_0`$, the ordinary multipoint Seshadri constant at r very general points equals the volume bound $`(L^n/r)^{1/n}`$. This establishes the qualitative Nagata–Biran–Szemberg assertion in these dimensions.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 极化曲面的 Seshadri 极值
items.explanation_zh: 研究任意光滑曲面多点正性常数的最大值。
items.source_title: Maximal Seshadri constants on arbitrary polarized surfaces
items.source_abstract: We prove that, for every smooth integral complex projective surface S and every ample line bundle L, the multipoint Seshadri constant at r very general points equals $`\sqrt{L^2/r}`$ for every sufficiently large integer r. This resolves positively the qualitative Nagata–Biran conjecture for surfaces.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 正特征中的多点 Seshadri 常数
items.explanation_zh: 研究正特征几何中的局部线丛正性。
items.source_title: Maximal multipoint Seshadri constants in positive characteristic
items.source_abstract: Let L be an ample line bundle on a smooth integral projective variety X over an algebraically closed field of positive characteristic, with $`\dim X=n\ge3`$. We prove that there is a threshold $`r_0=r_0(X,L)`$ such that for every integer $`r\ge r_0`$, the ordinary multipoint Seshadri constant at the geometric generic tuple of r points equals the volume bound $`(L^n/r)^{1/n}`$. The same conclusion holds in dimension two. This establishes the positive-characteristic form of the qualitative Nagata–Biran–Szemberg assertion at geometric generic tuples.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 平均收益奇偶博弈
items.explanation_zh: 用拟多项式算法计算收益与奇偶约束的策略。
items.source_title: Mean-payoff parity games in quasipolynomial time
items.source_abstract: We give a uniform deterministic quasipolynomial-time algorithm for mean-payoff parity games. It computes all vertices from which a player can enforce both nonnegative liminf mean payoff and the parity condition, with arbitrary signed binary rewards and unrestricted binary priorities. The running time is $`2^{O((\log(L+2))^2)}`$ bit operations, where L is the complete input length.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 无噪高斯回归的内存与精度
items.explanation_zh: 比较精确观测下学习内存与恢复能力。
items.source_title: Memory and precision in noiseless Gaussian regression
items.source_abstract: For every fixed A > 0, a learner that retains at most $`Ad^2`$ bits between fresh exact Gaussian linear measurements needs $`\Omega_A(d\log(1/\epsilon))`$ measurements to estimate a uniformly random unit vector to angular error at most ϵ, for any $`0\lt \epsilon\le 1/10`$, with probability at least 2/3. The constant is absolute for $`o(d^2)`$ memory.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: ℓ¹ 的度量 Markov 余型
items.explanation_zh: 研究随机游走数据在 ℓ¹ 中的平均行为。
items.source_title: Metric Markov Cotype Two of ℓ1
items.source_abstract: We prove that the real Banach space ℓ1 has metric Markov cotype two, answering a question of Mendel and Naor. As a consequence, every Lipschitz map from an arbitrary subset of a real Hilbert space into ℓ1 extends to the whole Hilbert space with a universal multiplicative loss in its Lipschitz constant, resolving Ball's extension problem for this target.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 度量下降与保秩收缩
items.explanation_zh: 从半正反典范度量构造保持秩的几何变换。
items.source_title: Metric descent and rank-preserving contractions
items.source_abstract: From a smooth semipositive anticanonical metric on a smooth projective complex variety, we construct an unweighted integrable semipositive metric on a corrected anticanonical line of a smooth base, using a normal equidimensional toroidal model and full generic adjoint rank one at exponent zero. The explicit rational boundary correction pulls back to an exceptional divisor. On varieties without positive-degree holomorphic forms, two-metric transfer gives sections with prescribed boundary poles from a finite-volume log-anticanonical metric and a target line with bounded semipositive weights. In particular, a smooth projective complex variety with a smoothly semipositive anticanonical bundle and no such forms has a nonzero invariant section of a positive anticanonical multiple for every torus action with its natural linearization. On this class of varieties, generic section and adjoint-rank hypotheses give contractions of invariant fibrations that preserve both conditions unless an invariant global section already exists.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: FK 与生成树地图的度量极限
items.explanation_zh: 研究离散随机地图的距离和测度如何连续化。
items.source_title: Metric-measure limits of subcritical FK and spanning-tree planar maps
items.source_abstract: We resolve the finite spherical cases of Gwynne and Miller's graph-metric conjecture for critical Fortuin–Kasteleyn maps at each fixed $`q\in(0,4)`$ and for uniform spanning-tree-decorated maps. After deterministic rescaling of graph distances, these maps, equipped with the vertex probability measure proportional to degree, converge in Gromov–Hausdorff–Prokhorov law to their ordinary unit-area Liouville quantum gravity spheres. Distances use every primal edge, and convergence holds through all positive integer edge counts.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 球面感知机的微观堵塞
items.explanation_zh: 研究负间隔模型的可行性阈值与接触分布。
items.source_title: Microscopic jamming in the negative spherical perceptron
items.source_abstract:
We prove a sharp feasibility threshold and limiting gap and force laws for the spherical perceptron with margin −1 and quadratic penalty. The limits are taken successively in system size, inverse temperature, and density approaching the threshold from above. They agree for Gaussian coordinates and for the equal mixture of centered Gaussian coordinates with variances $`1-\varepsilon`$ and $`1+\varepsilon`$, for every sufficiently small fixed ε. The contact-removed gap cumulative law and the mean-one force cumulative law satisfy

$`\displaystyle G_J(u)=u^{1-\gamma+o(1)},\qquad F_J(s)=s^{1+\theta+o(1)},`$

as $`u\downarrow0`$ and $`s\downarrow0`$, with $`\gamma=(2+\theta)^{-1}`$, $`0.4126930\lt \gamma\lt 0.4126934`$, and $`0.4231063\lt \theta\lt 0.4231088`$. A finite numerical certificate for these exponent intervals, together with its mathematical error bounds, is included.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 树势与路径成本的中点凸性
items.explanation_zh: 从有界树势估计 Banach 空间的渐近凸性。
items.source_title: Midpoint convexity from bounded tree potentials and path costs
items.source_abstract: Four real Banach spaces defined by bounded tree potentials satisfy the averaged asymptotic midpoint bound $`\widehat\delta(t)\ge\sqrt{1+t^2/4}-1`$ for $`0\lt t\lt 1`$, while none admits an asymptotically uniformly convex (AUC) renorming. On finite-height trees, the globally constrained norm equals the least additive cost of a Hilbert vector and root paths. The quadratic path and segment-start outer Hilbert sums are reflexive and asymptotically midpoint uniformly convex, and admit no equivalent AUC norm.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 递归势产生的中点凸性
items.explanation_zh: 用两个递归场研究树范数的几何性质。
items.source_title: Midpoint convexity from two recursive potentials
items.source_abstract: We study tree norms computed by two least nonnegative fields whose difference is the vector. For Euclidean child aggregation, two root-sum spaces have an averaged asymptotic midpoint modulus of at least $`t^3/128`$ for $`0\lt t\lt 1`$, including a reflexive joining-root space. A reflexive construction with a fixed zero root also satisfies a homogeneous cubic estimate. These spaces admit no equivalent asymptotically uniformly convex norm. We also obtain sixth-power and cubic estimates when the aggregation exponent depends on the height of a finite component.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 线段空间中的中点透镜
items.explanation_zh: 研究线段森林对偶空间的中点结构。
items.source_title: Midpoint lenses in segment spaces
items.source_abstract: For a real segment-forest dual with unbounded finite component heights and the real infinite-height coordinate predual, we bound the tail of an arbitrary displacement in a symmetric lens by $`2\sqrt{R^2-\|x\|^2}`$, where R is the lens radius and x is its finitely supported center. Both given norms are asymptotically midpoint uniformly convex, although neither space admits an equivalent asymptotically uniformly convex norm. The finite-height forest dual is reflexive.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 阿贝尔簇的 Milne 有理性
items.explanation_zh: 研究 Hodge 类配对在不同上同调实现中的有理性。
items.source_title: Milne's rationality conjecture for abelian varieties
items.source_abstract: We prove Milne's rationality conjecture for abelian varieties, including residue characteristic 2. After good reduction, the pairing of a rational Hodge class with any complementary product of divisor classes on the reduction is the same rational number in every prime-to-p realization and in crystalline cohomology. Using the Hodge theorem for CM abelian varieties, we also show that every such specialized Hodge class is represented by a single rational algebraic cycle in all these realizations.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 极小度量与内部单射性
items.explanation_zh: 研究数值有效伴随除子的内部截面结构。
items.source_title: Minimal metrics and interior injectivity for nef adjoints
items.source_abstract: Let $`(H,\Theta)`$ be a projective complex klt pair with effective rational boundary and nef ℚ-Cartier adjoint. On any projective log resolution, minimal semipositive metrics on the pulled-back adjoint exist and have zero Lelong numbers everywhere. On smooth projective complex varieties, we also prove an H1-injectivity theorem for rational interior boundaries with simple-normal-crossing support when both endpoint bundles carry zero-Lelong semipositive metrics.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 广义对数对的极小模型
items.explanation_zh: 研究极小模型或 Mori 纤维空间的存在。
items.source_title: Minimal models and Mori fibre spaces for generalized log canonical Q-pairs
items.source_abstract: We resolve the existence form of the minimal-model conjecture for projective generalized log canonical ℚ-pairs over algebraically closed fields of characteristic zero. Such a pair admits a minimal model when its adjoint divisor is pseudo-effective, and a Mori fibre space otherwise, while keeping the nef ℚ-Cartier b-divisor fixed. Taking the nef part to be zero gives the corresponding result for ordinary log canonical ℚ-pairs.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 数值维数一的极小模型
items.explanation_zh: 研究复射影空间典范除子的双有理模型。
items.source_title: Minimal models in numerical dimension one
items.source_abstract: We resolve the numerical-dimension-one case of the minimal-model conjecture for smooth connected complex projective varieties of dimension at least three. If KX is pseudo-effective and $`\kappa_\sigma(X,K_X)=1`$, with κσ defined by section growth with a fixed ample twist, then X admits a projective ℚ-factorial terminal minimal model.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 虚二次数域上的椭圆曲线模性
items.explanation_zh: 联系椭圆曲线与虚二次数域中的自守形式。
items.source_title: Modularity of elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields
items.source_abstract: We prove the modularity conjecture for elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields: every such curve is modular, with matching local parameters at every place.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 正整数中的单色和与积
items.explanation_zh: 研究有限染色中能否同时找到单色有限和积。
items.source_title: Monochromatic finite sums and products in the positive integers
items.source_abstract: We prove Hindman's finite sums and products conjecture: for every finite coloring of the positive integers and every positive integer k, there is a k-element set whose nonempty subset sums and nonempty subset products all have the same color.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 平面曲线的 Nagata 猜想
items.explanation_zh: 联系曲线次数与许多一般点处的重数。
items.source_title: Nagata's conjecture for plane curves
items.source_abstract: We prove that a nonzero effective plane curve of degree d at r ≥ 10 very general complex points has total multiplicity strictly less than $`d\sqrt r`$. The inequality holds simultaneously for all curves, including reducible and nonreduced curves, and establishes Nagata's conjecture in its strict, nonhomogeneous form.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 临界 FK 界面的自然占据测度
items.explanation_zh: 研究随机界面点数测度的连续极限。
items.source_title: Natural Occupation Measures for Critical Square-Lattice FK Interfaces
items.source_abstract: We prove that the rescaled counting measure of a critical square-lattice Fortuin–Kasteleyn Dobrushin interface in the unit square converges to the Minkowski-content measure of its Schramm–Loewner limit, for every fixed cluster weight $`1\le q\lt 4`$. A single deterministic constant times the predicted power of the mesh gives the normalization. Convergence is joint with the ordered curve and includes the total mass, giving the scaling limit of the interface's total number of steps.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 近包含算子代数的空间嵌入
items.explanation_zh: 检验一侧距离很近是否产生小酉变换嵌入。
items.source_title: Near Inclusions of von Neumann Algebras Without Small Spatial Embeddings
items.source_abstract: We give a negative answer to the unrestricted small-spatial-embedding problem for one-sided near inclusions of von Neumann algebras. On separable complex Hilbert spaces, we construct pairs of unital von Neumann algebras with common identity whose one-sided gaps tend to zero. Spatial embeddings of the source into the target exist, but every implementing unitary stays a fixed positive distance from the identity. The obstruction therefore concerns small implementing unitaries, rather than the existence of spatial embeddings.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 最稀疏割的半正定整数差距
items.explanation_zh: 构造松弛解与真实图割相差很大的实例。
items.source_title: Near-square-root logarithmic integrality gaps for uniform sparsest cut
items.source_abstract: We construct uniform sparsest-cut instances whose Goemans–Linial semidefinite integrality gap is at least $`c\sqrt{\log n}/(\log\log n)^3`$ along a sequence $`n\to\infty`$. The demand is one between every pair of distinct vertices, and the capacities are nonnegative real numbers. This matches the Arora–Rao–Vazirani upper bound up to a power of $`\log\log n`$.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Littlewood 多项式的最大与最小值
items.explanation_zh: 同时控制正负一系数多项式在圆周上的振幅。
items.source_title: Nearly minimal maxima and positive minima of Littlewood polynomials
items.source_abstract: For every η > 0 and every sufficiently large integer N, there is a polynomial with N consecutive coefficients in $`\{-1,1\}`$ whose modulus lies between $`\sqrt N/16`$ and $`(1+\eta)\sqrt N`$ everywhere on the unit circle.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 平面首达渗流的双向测地线
items.explanation_zh: 研究双向无限最短路径是否存在。
items.source_title: No bigeodesics in planar first-passage percolation
items.source_abstract: We prove that planar first-passage percolation with independent identically distributed nonnegative nonatomic edge weights has almost surely no doubly infinite geodesic, provided the minimum of four independent weights has finite second moment. This resolves the planar no-bigeodesics conjecture under that moment assumption. The conclusion rules out all bigeodesics simultaneously, without any regularity assumption on the limit shape.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 准传递图的临界渗流
items.explanation_zh: 研究临界点处无限连通簇是否存在。
items.source_title: No percolation at criticality on quasi-transitive graphs
items.source_abstract: We prove that critical Bernoulli bond percolation has no infinite cluster on any infinite connected locally finite quasi-transitive graph with critical probability less than one. This resolves the bond form of the criticality conjecture of Benjamini and Schramm.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 同伦相同却不同胚的四维流形
items.explanation_zh: 比较无高阶同伦流形的同伦与拓扑结构。
items.source_title: Nonhomeomorphic closed aspherical four-manifolds with the same homotopy type
items.source_abstract: We construct closed connected aspherical topological four-manifolds that are homotopy equivalent but not homeomorphic, disproving the homeomorphism-existence formulation of the Borel conjecture in dimension four. Their common fundamental group is word-hyperbolic. One of the manifolds also has a self-homotopy equivalence not homotopic to a homeomorphism.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 任意群上的非奇异方程组
items.explanation_zh: 研究有限方程组能否在扩张群中同时求解。
items.source_title: Nonsingular systems of equations over arbitrary groups
items.source_abstract: Every finite nonsingular system of equations over an arbitrary group has a simultaneous solution in an overgroup. This proves Howie's conjecture on nonsingular systems.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Markov 型与超自反性
items.explanation_zh: 联系随机游走的度量行为与 Banach 几何。
items.source_title: Nontrivial Markov Type Forces Superreflexivity
items.source_abstract: We prove that every real Banach space with Markov type p > 1 is superreflexive. Together with the known converse, this characterizes superreflexivity by nontrivial Markov type. This answers Naor's question: every real Banach space with nontrivial Markov type admits an equivalent uniformly smooth norm.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 三维标量电导率的非唯一性
items.explanation_zh: 研究不同电导率能否产生相同边界观测。
items.source_title: Nonuniqueness for bounded measurable scalar conductivities in three dimensions
items.source_abstract: We construct two distinct uniformly positive bounded measurable scalar conductivities on a ball in ℝ3 with the same full Dirichlet-to-Neumann operator. Both conductivities equal one near the boundary. This gives nonuniqueness in the scalar Calderón problem at bounded measurable regularity.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 周期硬球 Boltzmann 方程的非唯一性
items.explanation_zh: 研究相同初值能否产生不同的整体解。
items.source_title: Nonuniqueness for the periodic hard-sphere Boltzmann equation
items.source_abstract: We prove nonuniqueness for the periodic hard-sphere Boltzmann equation by constructing two distinct global renormalized solutions with the same nonnegative initial density on $`\mathbb T^3\times\mathbb R^3`$. This density has bounded velocity support and finite mass, energy, and absolute entropy. Both solutions conserve local mass and total momentum and satisfy the global energy and entropy-dissipation inequalities. On a common initial interval, they are strongly continuous in L1, and their collision gains and losses are integrable.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 非可和图上的渗流非唯一性
items.explanation_zh: 研究多个无限连通簇同时存在的参数范围。
items.source_title: Nonuniqueness of percolation on nonamenable quasi-transitive graphs
items.source_abstract: We prove the bond-percolation nonuniqueness conjecture of Benjamini and Schramm: every infinite connected, locally finite, nonamenable quasi-transitive graph has a nonempty interval of parameters for which Bernoulli bond percolation almost surely has infinitely many infinite clusters. We also prove Hutchcroft's stronger operator-threshold conjecture, establishing $`p_c\lt p_{2\to2}\le p_u`$.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 局部守恒下的 Boltzmann 非唯一性
items.explanation_zh: 检验质量、动量与能量守恒是否保证唯一解。
items.source_title: Nonuniqueness with local conservation for the hard-sphere Boltzmann equation
items.source_abstract: We prove nonuniqueness for the three-dimensional periodic hard-sphere Boltzmann equation among global entropy solutions satisfying exact local conservation of mass, momentum, and kinetic energy. We construct one nonnegative initial density with bounded velocity support and finite mass, energy, and absolute entropy that gives rise to two distinct such solutions. Both are strongly continuous in L1, and their collision gain and loss terms are integrable with every polynomial velocity weight on every bounded time interval.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 核维数与 Jiang–Su 稳定性
items.explanation_zh: 比较没有初等子商的核 C* 代数的两种性质。
items.source_title: Nuclear dimension and Jiang–Su stability without elementary subquotients
items.source_abstract: For separable nuclear C∗-algebras with no nonzero elementary ideal subquotients, finite nuclear dimension is equivalent to Jiang–Su stability. More generally, $`\dim_{\mathrm{nuc}}(A_0\otimes\mathcal Z)\le1`$ for every separable nuclear A0. This proves Robert and Tikuisis's Conjecture (C1) and the nuclear-dimension equivalence in the nonsimple Toms–Winter regularity question.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 数值有效伴随除子的半丰沛性
items.explanation_zh: 研究数值条件能否产生足够的代数截面。
items.source_title: Numerical Semiampleness of Nef Adjoint Divisors
items.source_abstract: We prove the Generalised Abundance Conjecture: if $`(X,B)`$ is a projective klt ℚ-pair over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, $`K_X+B`$ is pseudo-effective, M is a nef ℚ-Cartier divisor on X, and $`K_X+B+M`$ is nef, then $`K_X+B+M`$ is numerically equivalent to a semiample ℚ-Cartier divisor on X.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 紧 Kähler 流形的数值半丰沛性
items.explanation_zh: 研究数值有效伴随类的几何实现。
items.source_title: Numerical semiampleness of nef adjoint classes on compact Kähler manifolds
items.source_abstract: Let X be a smooth connected compact Kähler manifold, let B be an effective rational simple normal crossing divisor with coefficients less than one, and let M be a nef rational holomorphic line bundle on X. If $`K_X+B`$ is pseudo-effective and $`K_X+B+M`$ is nef, we prove that its first Chern class in real Bott–Chern cohomology is represented by a semiample rational line bundle. This numerical statement allows a flat change of line bundle; it does not assert semiampleness of the original adjoint.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 非交换公式的单点检测
items.explanation_zh: 构造一组有理矩阵检测非零非交换表达式。
items.source_title: One Rational Matrix Hitting Point for Noncommutative Formulas
items.source_abstract: We construct, in deterministic polynomial bit time, one tuple of rational matrices that detects every nonzero polynomial computed by a noncommutative division-free formula of a prescribed size. The matrices have dimension $`O(ns^2)`$ for n variables and formula size s, and the same tuple works over every field of characteristic zero.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 单样本拟阵先知不等式
items.explanation_zh: 研究面对强对手时有限样本的在线选择能力。
items.source_title: One Sample Suffices for Matroid Prophet Inequalities against an Almighty Adversary
items.source_abstract: We prove that one independent sample per element suffices for a constant-competitive prophet inequality on every finite matroid. The guarantee holds even when the arrival-order adversary observes all samples, all online values, and the algorithm's entire random seed. The rule needs no description of the value distributions and achieves the absolute competitive ratio $`2^{-310}`$.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 单侧负曲率与全纯 Liouville 性
items.explanation_zh: 比较负曲率条件和有界全纯函数的行为。
items.source_title: One-sided negative sectional curvature and the holomorphic Liouville property
items.source_abstract: We construct, in some sufficiently large fixed finite complex dimension m, a domain in ℂm diffeomorphic to $`\mathbb R^{2m}`$ that admits a complete Kähler metric with real sectional curvature at most −1 and has only constant bounded holomorphic functions. Its sectional curvatures are unbounded below. The construction gives a negative answer to the one-sided bounded-holomorphic-function question.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Galois 群的开同态
items.explanation_zh: 研究数域绝对 Galois 群之间的连续开映射。
items.source_title: Open Homomorphisms of Global Solvably Closed Galois Groups
items.source_abstract: We prove Uchida's conjecture on open homomorphisms of Galois groups. Every continuous open homomorphism between Galois groups of solvably closed Galois extensions of number fields is induced by a unique equivariant field embedding in the opposite direction. No restriction on the kernel or additional compatibility hypothesis is required.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Thorp 洗牌的最优混合阶
items.explanation_zh: 估计洗牌次数如何随牌数的对数增长。
items.source_title: Optimal-order mixing of the Thorp shuffle
items.source_abstract: We prove that the Thorp shuffle on $`2^d`$ cards mixes in $`\Theta(d)`$ complete shuffles. The full permutation law after $`1600d`$ shuffles converges to uniform in total variation as $`d\to\infty`$, uniformly over the initial deck, while a support count gives a lower bound of $`2d-O(1)`$.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 轨形与对数 Iitaka 次可加性
items.explanation_zh: 比较整体空间、底空间和纤维的 Kodaira 维数。
items.source_title: Orbifold and logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity
items.source_abstract: We prove Campana's orbifold Iitaka subadditivity conjecture for rational simple normal crossing boundaries on compact manifolds in Fujiki class $`\mathcal C`$, including coefficient one. Ordinary and logarithmic subadditivity follow.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 乘法函数的二点关联
items.explanation_zh: 研究 Liouville 函数沿两条仿射表达式的关联。
items.source_title: Ordinary two-point correlations of multiplicative functions
items.source_abstract: We prove the ordinary two-point Chowla conjecture. For every fixed pair of nonproportional affine forms, the Liouville correlation has a power-of-logarithm saving at every cutoff, with an absolute exponent. We also prove the binary corrected Elliott conjecture for ordinary averages of complex multiplicative functions of modulus at most one, under uniform nonpretentiousness of at least one original factor. This qualitative conclusion holds in fixed residue classes and for fixed nonproportional affine forms.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 复合秩下的 P=W 猜想
items.explanation_zh: 比较 Higgs 模空间中的几何滤过与权滤过。
items.source_title: P=W in composite rank for fixed determinant
items.source_abstract: We prove the P = W conjecture on the full rational cohomology of fixed-determinant, trace-free Higgs moduli spaces in composite rank and coprime degree, for smooth projective complex curves of genus at least two. Together with the established prime-rank cases, this gives the equality in every coprime rank.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 三正则二部平面图的 Hamilton 环
items.explanation_zh: 研究能否用一个环经过所有顶点。
items.source_title: Paired states and Hamiltonian cycles in cubic bipartite planar graphs
items.source_abstract: We prove Barnette's conjecture: every finite simple cubic bipartite planar 3-vertex-connected graph has a Hamiltonian cycle.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Artin 群的抛物子群交
items.explanation_zh: 研究任意抛物子群相交后是否仍为抛物子群。
items.source_title: Parabolic intersections in Artin groups
items.source_abstract: We prove that every intersection of parabolic subgroups of any finite-rank Artin group, with arbitrary finite or infinite Coxeter labels, is parabolic. This resolves the Parabolic Intersection Conjecture affirmatively.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Weisfeiler–Leman 等价见证
items.explanation_zh: 用奇偶提升与树宽有界图分析图识别能力。
items.source_title: Parity lifts and bounded-treewidth witnesses for Weisfeiler–Leman equivalence
items.source_abstract: For k ≥ 4, we construct two uncolored graphs that are k-dimensional Weisfeiler–Leman equivalent exactly when a prescribed finite-domain choice system has no compatible choice. The system has $`k+1`$ domains for joint refinement and k for separate-coordinate refinement. A successful choice is detected after two joint rounds or one separate round. Applied to sparse satisfiability, the reduction gives fixed-dimension $`n^{\Omega(k)}`$ time exclusions under positive-rate ETH, even for deciding equality of these early histograms.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 退化 Ricci 平坦树上的椭圆界
items.explanation_zh: 用路径选择控制重整化几何能量。
items.source_title: Path selection and an elliptic inequality on degenerating Ricci-flat trees
items.source_abstract: We prove a sequential elliptic inequality for the renormalized Einstein–Hilbert functional on a fixed finite tree of four-dimensional Ricci-flat spaces. As the joining lengths diverge and the scale-neutral weighted Ricci error M tends to zero, the functional satisfies $`E=o(M)`$. The root end has decay exponent greater than one, and every joined quotient group is nontrivial. We also prove the multivariable path-selection theorem for asymptotic expansions used to obtain this estimate.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 完美完备的二对一博弈
items.explanation_zh: 研究约束博弈中区分完全可满足实例的难度。
items.source_title: Perfect completeness for 2-to-1 games
items.source_abstract: We prove the 2-to-1 Games Conjecture with perfect completeness. For every fixed rational $`\delta\in(0,1)`$, it is NP-hard to distinguish satisfiable 2-to-1 games from games of value at most δ, with a fixed alphabet and an explicitly listed unweighted multiset of constraints.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Petty 投影体体积猜想
items.explanation_zh: 比较固定体积凸体的投影体极小值。
items.source_title: Petty’s projection-volume conjecture in dimensions at least four
items.source_abstract: We prove that ellipsoids uniquely minimize the volume of the projection body among convex bodies of fixed volume in every dimension at least four. This proves Petty's projection-volume conjecture in these dimensions.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 平面图距离的 L¹ 嵌入
items.explanation_zh: 研究能否用统一距离扭曲表示平面图。
items.source_title: Planar Graph Metrics Embed into L1 with Constant Distortion
items.source_abstract: We prove that every finite connected planar graph with arbitrary positive real edge lengths embeds into real L1 with a universal distortion bound. This resolves the planar embedding conjecture positively.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 混合变换的多重遍历平均
items.explanation_zh: 研究多个时间尺度乘积的逐点收敛。
items.source_title: Pointwise Multiple Ergodic Averages for Mixing Transformations
items.source_abstract: Let T be an invertible mixing probability-preserving transformation. For every integer n ≥ 2 and every fixed tuple of bounded measurable functions, we prove that the consecutive multiple ergodic averages of length n converge almost everywhere to the product of the integrals, as the averaging length tends to infinity through all positive integers. The probability space need not be standard, and no rate of mixing is required.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 四重遍历平均的逐点收敛
items.explanation_zh: 研究 n、2n、3n、4n 时刻的平均。
items.source_title: Pointwise convergence of fourfold ergodic averages for mixing transformations
items.source_abstract: We prove that fourfold ergodic averages along the times $`n,2n,3n,4n`$ converge almost everywhere to the product of the integrals for every invertible, bimeasurable, mixing probability-preserving transformation and every fixed choice of bounded measurable inputs. Convergence holds along all positive integer averaging lengths. No quantitative mixing rate is assumed, and the probability space need not be standard.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 三重遍历平均的逐点收敛
items.explanation_zh: 研究混合动力系统中三时刻乘积的极限。
items.source_title: Pointwise convergence of triple ergodic averages for mixing transformations
items.source_abstract:
We prove pointwise convergence of triple ergodic averages for every invertible mixing probability preserving transformation T of an arbitrary probability space $`(X,\mathcal F,\mu)`$, with measurable inverse. For every triple of bounded measurable functions $`f_1,f_2,f_3:X\to\mathbb C`$,

$`\displaystyle \frac1N\sum_{n=1}^N f_1(T^nx)f_2(T^{2n}x)f_3(T^{3n}x) \longrightarrow \prod_{j=1}^3\int_X f_j\,d\mu`$

for μ-almost every x as $`N\to\infty`$ through all positive integers.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 非交换有理公式的检测列表
items.explanation_zh: 构造多项式规模的矩阵测试集合。
items.source_title: Polynomial Hitting Lists for Noncommutative Rational Formulas
items.source_abstract: We construct, in deterministic polynomial bit time, a polynomial-size list of rational matrix tuples for noncommutative rational formulas over ℚ of bounded tree size. Every nonzero admissible formula has a defined, invertible value at one tuple, with no separate bounds on inverse nesting or rational constant heights. Matrix dimensions, entry bit lengths, and total output length are polynomially bounded.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 固定度序列图的交换链混合
items.explanation_zh: 估计随机换边算法生成图的混合时间。
items.source_title: Polynomial mixing of the switch chain for every graphical degree sequence
items.source_abstract: We prove the simple-undirected form of the Kannan–Tetali–Vempala conjecture: the switch chain on simple undirected graphs mixes in polynomial time for every graphical degree sequence. For a lazy chain that proposes switches uniformly on four vertices, the total-variation mixing time at distance 1/4 is at most $`2n^8`$. We also give an exactly uniform sampler for every graphical labeled degree vector. It uses unbiased random bits, terminates almost surely, and has expected polynomial bit running time.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 有能隙格点基态的 PEPS 近似
items.explanation_zh: 用多项式规模张量网络表示二维量子基态。
items.source_title: Polynomial PEPS approximation of gapped square-grid ground states
items.source_abstract: We prove that the unique ground state of a uniformly gapped nearest-neighbor Hamiltonian on an $`L\times L`$ square lattice admits a projected entangled-pair state approximation with bond dimension polynomial in L and global vector error at most L−1 after normalization. Only the gap of the full Hamiltonian is assumed. The result is an existence theorem, with constants uniform over Hamiltonians of fixed local dimension, interaction strength, and gap.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 布尔预言机到酉操作
items.explanation_zh: 研究从布尔查询高效合成量子酉变换。
items.source_title: Polynomial-Time Unitary Synthesis from a Boolean Oracle
items.source_abstract: We give a positive answer to the constant-error formulation of the Aaronson–Kuperberg unitary synthesis problem. For every n, a quantum oracle circuit generated in polynomial time from n alone can approximate the channel of every n-qubit unitary to full diamond-norm error at most 1/2, after a suitable Boolean oracle is chosen. Using the fixed gates $`H,T,T^\dagger,\mathrm{CNOT}`$, the circuit has polynomially many qubits, elementary gates, and oracle calls, and its oracle queries have polynomial length. The oracle may depend on the target unitary; the theorem does not give an efficient classical procedure for constructing it.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 有序二进制矩阵的移除界
items.explanation_zh: 构造不能满足多项式移除估计的矩阵模式。
items.source_title: Polynomial removal fails for ordered binary matrices
items.source_abstract: We construct a fixed $`66\times66`$ binary matrix for which ordered matrix removal has no polynomial bound. This disproves the polynomial ordered binary matrix-removal conjecture. Ordered copies preserve the separate row and column orders and match both zeros and ones; removal permits changing entries in either direction.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 蜂窝桥路径的多项式表示
items.explanation_zh: 研究临界路径的真空表示与桥质量。
items.source_title: Polynomial vacuum representations and bridge mass for honeycomb walks
items.source_abstract: We prove that, under the all-length critical measure, a honeycomb bridge crossing a strip of h layers, with its initial port fixed and its terminal port free, has mean length $`h^{4/3+o(1)}`$. We also obtain central visit probability $`R^{-2/3+o(1)}`$ and mean length $`R^{4/3+o(1)}`$ for macroscopic free-boundary chords in a regular hexagon.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 标准映射的正度量熵
items.explanation_zh: 研究大参数下经典二维混沌映射的复杂度。
items.source_title: Positive Metric Entropy for the Standard Map at Large Parameters
items.source_abstract: We prove that the standard sine map of the two-dimensional torus has positive metric entropy with respect to normalized area for every sufficiently large positive parameter. This gives a full parameter tail, and hence answers Sinai's positive-parameter-measure conjecture affirmatively.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: SU(2) BFSS Hamilton 量的正谱
items.explanation_zh: 研究相对量子 Hamilton 量中的正特征值。
items.source_title: Positive eigenvalues of the relative SU(2) BFSS Hamiltonian
items.source_abstract: We prove that the relative $`\mathop{\mathrm{SU}}\nolimits (2)`$ BFSS Hamiltonian has infinitely many positive eigenvalues tending to infinity, with square-integrable eigenvectors. The operator is defined by closing the gauge-invariant supercharge form. This refutes, at N = 2, the exclusion of normalizable positive-energy states stated in the original BFSS paper.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 大素数间隙的正密度
items.explanation_zh: 研究超过任意指定对数尺度的素数间隙比例。
items.source_title: Positive lower density of large prime gaps
items.source_abstract: For every fixed C > 0, we prove that a positive proportion of consecutive prime gaps exceed $`C\log p`$, where p is the smaller prime. The proportion is bounded below for every sufficiently large initial segment of the prime sequence, with a constant depending on C. It follows that the indices at which $`p_n/n`$ increases have positive lower asymptotic density, answering a question of Erdős and Prachar.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 正标量曲率与余维二宽度
items.explanation_zh: 研究曲率条件如何限制空间的有效宽度。
items.source_title: Positive scalar curvature and uniform codimension-two width
items.source_abstract: We prove the quantitative continuous form of Gromov's scalar-curvature conjecture in every dimension n ≥ 4. Every complete connected smooth boundaryless n-manifold with scalar curvature at least one admits a continuous map to a simplicial complex of dimension at most $`n-2`$ whose entire fibers have diameter bounded only in terms of n. We also obtain the continuous macroscopic-dimension conclusion for universal covers of closed manifolds with positive scalar curvature in every dimension n ≥ 2.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 正标量曲率与拓扑非本质性
items.explanation_zh: 研究正曲率流形基本类在分类空间中的像。
items.source_title: Positive scalar curvature forces rational inessentiality
items.source_abstract: We prove that every closed connected oriented smooth manifold admitting strictly positive scalar curvature is rationally inessential: its rational fundamental class maps to zero under the classifying map. No spin or fundamental-group hypothesis is needed, and there is no upper dimension bound. This proves the Gromov–Lawson aspherical conjecture; moreover, every nonnegative-scalar-curvature metric on a closed aspherical manifold is flat. We also show that every closed oriented smooth manifold of positive dimension with nonnegative scalar curvature has zero real simplicial volume, proving the qualitative vanishing consequence of Gromov's conjectural comparison.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 正曲率 Einstein 四维流形
items.explanation_zh: 研究满足 Einstein 条件的四维空间分类。
items.source_title: Positively curved Einstein four-manifolds
items.source_abstract: We prove the classification conjecture for connected smooth closed Einstein four-manifolds with strictly positive sectional curvature. Up to positive scaling and isometry, every such manifold is the round four-sphere, the complex projective plane with its Fubini–Study metric, or real projective four-space with its round metric. No orientability assumption is needed.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Serre 相交重数的正性
items.explanation_zh: 研究代数几何相交数在混合特征下的符号。
items.source_title: Positivity of Serre's Intersection Multiplicity
items.source_abstract: We prove Serre's positivity conjecture, including ramified mixed characteristic. If two nonzero finitely generated modules over a regular local ring have tensor product of finite length and complementary dimensions, then their intersection multiplicity is strictly positive.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 高斯回归的后验副本
items.explanation_zh: 估计条件观测后保留的信息量。
items.source_title: Posterior replicas and conditional information in Gaussian regression
items.source_abstract: For a signal with density bounded by L relative to uniform probability on $`S^{d-1}`$, we bound the information in a finite message W formed from exact Gaussian measurements, conditional on an independent projection revealed only to the analyst. For explicit row counts proportional to d, the bound is $`O(H(W)/d+d+\log(2+\log L))`$. Consequently, a finite-state learner with $`o(d^2)`$ persistent bits and a deterministic sample horizon needs $`\Omega(d\log(1/\epsilon))`$ fresh noiseless Gaussian measurements for constant-probability angular accuracy $`0\lt \epsilon\le1/10`$ under the uniform spherical prior.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Yau 零点集上界的反例
items.explanation_zh: 研究 Laplace 特征函数零集体积的幂律增长。
items.source_title: Power-law violations of Yau's nodal upper bound
items.source_abstract: We construct a smooth Riemannian metric on $`S^4\times S^1`$ and a sequence of real Laplace eigenfunctions whose nodal four-volume grows faster than $`\lambda^{1/2+\epsilon_0}`$ for one fixed $`\epsilon_0\gt 0`$. This disproves the smooth upper-bound assertion in Yau's nodal-set conjecture and the proposed bound with an arbitrarily small positive power loss.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results
