The result allows attractive wells and dynamically formed clusters, without restrictions on the differential scattering cross-section.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 六维 Campana–Peternell 猜想
items.explanation_zh: 分类切丛数值有效的 Fano 六维簇。
items.source_title: The Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six
items.source_abstract: We prove that every smooth connected complex projective Fano sixfold with nef tangent bundle is rational homogeneous, resolving the Campana–Peternell conjecture in complex dimension six. As a consequence, a connected compact Kähler manifold X with nef holomorphic tangent bundle and $`\dim_{\mathbb C}X-\widetilde q(X)\leq6`$ has ordinary universal cover $`F\times\mathbb C^{\widetilde q(X)}`$, where F is a rational homogeneous manifold and $`\widetilde q(X)`$ is the maximal irregularity of a connected finite étale cover.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 平面 XY 模型的临界自旋场
items.explanation_zh: 研究临界点处离散自旋的连续缩放极限。
items.source_title: The Critical Spin Field of the Planar XY Model
items.source_abstract: Using the companion critical Bessel-height and pin-limit theorems, we prove that at the mass-defined critical inverse temperature of the nearest-neighbor XY model on the square lattice, the spin field on a square with boundary angles fixed to zero converges along the full sequence to the full-variance imaginary exponential of a zero-Dirichlet Gaussian free field with stiffness $`2/\pi`$. The normalization uses the exact center magnetization and the lattice Green-function factor. Convergence holds in law in $`H^{-3}_{\mathrm{loc}}((-1,1)^2)`$; all mixed moments and joint laws of fields smeared against smooth compactly supported test functions in $`(-1,1)^2`$ converge as well.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Deligne–Drinfeld 猜想
items.explanation_zh: 研究 Grothendieck–Teichmüller Lie 代数的生成结构。
items.source_title: The Deligne-Drinfeld conjecture
items.source_abstract: We prove the Deligne–Drinfeld conjecture: the rational Grothendieck–Teichmüller Lie algebra is freely generated by one element in every odd weight at least three, with the corresponding isomorphism after weight completion.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 奇数层级的 2 进 Hecke 代数
items.explanation_zh: 研究模形式对应代数的不可约分支维数。
items.source_title: The Dimension of the Two-Adic Hecke Algebra at Odd Level
items.source_abstract: For every odd positive integer N, every irreducible component of the full two-adic Hecke algebra of level $`\Gamma_1(N)`$ has Krull dimension four. This proves the p = 2 case of Emerton's dimension conjecture, including all residual components.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Zilber–Pink 的 E×CM 部分
items.explanation_zh: 研究阿贝尔曲面模空间曲线的特殊相交。
items.source_title: The E×CM component of Zilber–Pink for curves in A2
items.source_abstract: We prove the $`E\times\mathrm{CM}`$ component of Zilber–Pink for Hodge-generic algebraic curves in $`\mathcal A_2`$ over $`\overline{\mathbb Q}`$. Each such curve contains only finitely many points whose abelian surface is isogenous to a product of elliptic curves with at least one factor having complex multiplication.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 欧氏 Steinitz–Bergström 定理
items.explanation_zh: 给向量序列选择正负号，控制各部分和。
items.source_title: The Euclidean Steinitz–Bergström theorem
items.source_abstract: Every prescribed-order finite sequence of vectors in the Euclidean unit ball of ℝd has one signing for which every signed prefix has norm at most $`C\sqrt d`$, with C absolute and independent of the sequence length. Consequently, every indexed zero-sum family of unit-ball vectors admits an ordering with the same bound for its unsigned partial sums. This determines the Euclidean Steinitz constant up to absolute factors, $`S_2(d)=\Theta(\sqrt d)`$, and resolves the Euclidean Steinitz–Bergström conjecture.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 欧氏平面的五色着色
items.explanation_zh: 研究五种颜色能否避开单色单位距离点对。
items.source_title: The Euclidean plane is not five-colorable
items.source_abstract: We prove that every coloring of the Euclidean plane with five colors has a monochromatic unit-distance pair, with no regularity assumption on the color classes. Consequently, the chromatic number of the plane is either six or seven.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 顶点覆盖的两倍近似阈值
items.explanation_zh: 研究覆盖所有边所需顶点数的近似难度。
items.source_title: The Factor-Two Hardness Threshold for Vertex Cover
items.source_abstract: We prove that minimum Vertex Cover is NP-hard to approximate within every fixed factor below two, even on simple unweighted graphs.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 所有维数的 Falconer 距离问题
items.explanation_zh: 研究高维分形点集产生的距离集合。
items.source_title: The Falconer distance conjecture in all dimensions
items.source_abstract: We resolve the Falconer distance conjecture in every dimension. For every integer d ≥ 2, a compact subset of ℝd with Hausdorff dimension greater than $`d/2`$ determines a set of Euclidean distances of positive Lebesgue measure.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 高斯风车分割的极值
items.explanation_zh: 控制高斯分割各部分一阶矩平方和。
items.source_title: The Gaussian propeller bound in every dimension
items.source_abstract: We prove the Gaussian propeller conjecture: for every finite measurable partition of a Euclidean space, the sum of the squared lengths of its Gaussian first moments is at most $`9/(8\pi)`$. For dimension at least two and at least three cells, three planar sectors of angle $`2\pi/3`$, extended by an orthogonal Euclidean factor, attain the bound.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 双弧边界的整数高度场
items.explanation_zh: 研究三角格点高度的高斯自由场极限。
items.source_title: The Gaussian free field limit of integer Lipschitz heights with two-arc boundary data
items.source_abstract: We prove that the centered uniform odd integer height function on triangular-lattice approximations of a smooth simply connected domain, with neighboring differences zero or two and boundary values +1 and −1 on two arcs, converges to a universal multiple of the Dirichlet Gaussian free field. This resolves the field part of Schramm's Problem 2.2. We give an absolutely convergent finite-volume formula for the normalization. The proof combines reflection positivity, a spectral sum rule, and boundary comparison with Gaussian moment identities.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 平衡六顶点模型的高斯极限
items.explanation_zh: 计算格点高度场方差的参数系数。
items.source_title: The Gaussian free field limit of the balanced six-vertex model with variance multiplier 1/arcsin(c/2)
items.source_abstract: We prove that the height function of the square-lattice six-vertex model with weights $`a=b=1`$ and $`0\lt c\le2`$, in the plane state obtained from balanced tori, converges to a multiple of the Gaussian free field. For unit height jumps and Green kernel $`-(2\pi)^{-1}\log|x-y|`$, the squared multiplier is $`1/\arcsin(c/2)`$.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 广义 Mukai 猜想
items.explanation_zh: 联系 Fano 流形的维数、Picard 数与伪指数。
items.source_title: The generalized Mukai conjecture
items.source_abstract: We prove the generalized Mukai conjecture: every positive-dimensional smooth complex Fano manifold of dimension n, Picard number ρ, and pseudoindex ι satisfies $`\rho(\iota-1)\le n`$. Equality holds precisely for the product of ρ copies of $`\mathbb P^{\iota-1}`$.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Grothendieck 同伦假设
items.explanation_zh: 研究高阶群胚与同伦空间之间的对应。
items.source_title: The Grothendieck homotopy hypothesis via elementary expansions
items.source_abstract: We prove the Grothendieck homotopy hypothesis for every Grothendieck coherator in the Ara–Henry convention: its weak globular infinity-groupoids recover the homotopy theory of spaces. We also resolve Henry's pushout conjecture, showing that elementary expansions preserve components and all homotopy groups of cellular infinity-groupoids.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Hilbert–Smith 猜想
items.explanation_zh: 研究连续作用于有限维流形的局部紧群。
items.source_title: The Hilbert–Smith conjecture in every finite dimension
items.source_abstract: We prove the Hilbert–Smith conjecture in every finite dimension: every locally compact second-countable Hausdorff group acting faithfully and jointly continuously on a connected Hausdorff second-countable finite-dimensional topological manifold without boundary is a Lie group.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 平直三维环面的等周问题
items.explanation_zh: 分类固定体积下边界面积最小的区域。
items.source_title: The Isoperimetric Conjecture for the Cubic Flat Three-Torus
items.source_abstract: We prove the isoperimetric conjecture for the cubic flat three-torus and classify all minimizers, including the equality cases at the transition volumes $`4\pi/81`$ and $`1/\pi`$. The minimizing regions are balls, circular tubes about shortest closed geodesics, coordinate slabs, and their complements.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 三维 Kakeya 极大猜想
items.explanation_zh: 研究各方向细管中的最大平均。
items.source_title: The Kakeya maximal conjecture in three dimensions
items.source_abstract: We prove the Kakeya maximal conjecture in three dimensions. For every ε > 0, the maximal average over unit tubes of radius δ maps $`L^3(\mathbb R^3)`$ to $`L^3(S^2)`$ with norm at most $`C_\varepsilon\delta^{-\varepsilon}`$.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 轴对称带电旋转时空的面积界
items.explanation_zh: 联系 Kerr–Newman 质量、角动量和电荷。
items.source_title: The Kerr–Newman Penrose Inequality for Axisymmetric Electrovacuum Exteriors
items.source_abstract:
We prove the sharp Kerr–Newman Penrose inequality

$`\displaystyle m^2\ge \frac{A}{16\pi}+\frac{Q^2}{2} +\frac{\pi(Q^4+4J^2)}{A}.`$

Here $`Q^2=Q_e^2+Q_b^2`$, and J is the conserved total angular momentum, including its electromagnetic contribution. The result applies to smooth axisymmetric electrovacuum exteriors in the stated one-ended topological and decay class, with a connected outermost, outer-area-minimizing future marginally outer trapped boundary, Coulomb electromagnetic asymptotics, zero ADM momentum, and the explicitly assumed physical-area condition $`A\ge4\pi\sqrt{Q^4+4J^2}`$. No maximality assumption is made. On the strict area branch, equality within this class characterizes the original data as an admissible spacelike exterior slice of a subextremal dyonic Kerr–Newman spacetime, with the boundary mapped smoothly to a future-horizon cross-section or the bifurcation sphere.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 素数三处的 Kervaire 不变量
items.explanation_zh: 研究模三 Adams 谱序列中的特殊拓扑类。
items.source_title: The Kervaire invariant problem at the prime three
items.source_abstract: We solve the Kervaire invariant problem at the prime three for the standard Kervaire classes in the mod-three Adams spectral sequence. These classes survive precisely at indices 0, 2, and 3, and each surviving detection coset contains an element of additive order three. In particular, there is an order-three Kervaire element in stem 322.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 群的 Kervaire 定理
items.explanation_zh: 研究自由积所需的正规生成元素数量。
items.source_title: The Kervaire theorem for groups
items.source_abstract: We prove that no free product of a nontrivial group with an infinite cyclic group is normally generated by one element. This resolves the Kervaire conjecture positively.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Kirchberg–Rørdam 特征判据
items.explanation_zh: 联系中心序列无角色与 Jiang–Su 吸收。
items.source_title: The Kirchberg–Rørdam character criterion
items.source_abstract: We prove the Kirchberg–Rørdam character criterion: for every free ultrafilter on ℕ, a nonzero unital separable complex C∗-algebra absorbs the Jiang–Su algebra if and only if its norm central-sequence algebra has no characters. We also prove that the infinite minimal tensor power of every nonzero unital separable complex C∗-algebra without characters is $`\mathcal Z`$-stable and contains a unital copy of $`\mathcal Z`$.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 一般凸体的 Mahler 猜想
items.explanation_zh: 研究凸体及其极体的最小体积乘积。
items.source_title: The Mahler Conjecture for General Convex Bodies
items.source_abstract: We resolve the Mahler conjecture for general convex bodies positively. For every convex body $`K\subset\mathbb R^n`$, n ≥ 1, with Santaló point $`s(K)`$, $`|K|\,|(K-s(K))^\circ|\ge (n+1)^{n+1}/(n!)^2`$, with equality exactly for simplices.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 函数域的 Margulis–Platonov 猜想
items.explanation_zh: 研究代数群有理点的非中心正规子群。
items.source_title: The Margulis–Platonov conjecture over global function fields
items.source_abstract: We prove the Margulis–Platonov conjecture over every global function field, including characteristic two. For an absolutely almost simple simply connected algebraic group, every noncentral abstract normal subgroup of its rational points is the inverse image of an open normal subgroup of the finite product of its anisotropic local groups.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 数域的 Margulis–Platonov 猜想
items.explanation_zh: 由局部群描述有理点群的正规子群。
items.source_title: The Margulis–Platonov conjecture over number fields
items.source_abstract: We prove the Margulis–Platonov conjecture over number fields. For an absolutely almost simple simply connected group, every noncentral abstract normal subgroup of its rational points is the inverse image of an open normal subgroup of the product of its anisotropic nonarchimedean local groups.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 稀释自旋玻璃的 Mézard–Parisi 公式
items.explanation_zh: 研究分层腔方法给出的极限自由能。
items.source_title: The Mézard–Parisi formula for diluted spin glasses
items.source_abstract: We prove the Mézard–Parisi hierarchical cavity formula for diluted even-arity Ising models in the Panchenko–Talagrand class. This resolves the variational equality conjecture for that class: the limiting pressure equals the infimum of the trial functional over all finite hierarchy depths and trial laws. Only first moments of the interaction and external field are required.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: PPAD 的概率可检查证明
items.explanation_zh: 研究均衡计算问题的准线性局部验证归约。
items.source_title: The PCP-for-PPAD conjecture: a quasilinear reduction
items.source_abstract: We prove the quasilinear-size PCP-for-PPAD conjecture of Babichenko, Papadimitriou, and Rubinstein. There are fixed positive rational constants ε and δ and a deterministic polynomial-time reduction that transforms an End-of-Line instance of binary length N into a generalized circuit of total binary length $`N(\log N)^{O(1)}`$. From any rational assignment of polynomial encoding length that ε-satisfies all but a δ fraction of the gates, a solution to the original End-of-Line instance can be recovered in polynomial time, regardless of which gates fail. Such assignments always exist, with one fixed polynomial bound on their encoding length.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 划分原理与选择公理
items.explanation_zh: 研究划分原理是否足以推出选择公理。
items.source_title: The Partition Principle does not imply Choice
items.source_abstract: We prove that the Partition Principle does not imply the Axiom of Choice: if ZF is consistent, then so is ZF with the Partition Principle, Choice for ordinal-indexed families, and the negation of the Axiom of Choice. Separately, over every countable transitive model of ZFC, we construct a transitive symmetric model of this theory with the same ordinals and no new countable sequences of ground elements.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 渐近双曲初值的 Penrose 不等式
items.explanation_zh: 研究三维极大初值的质量与最小包围面积。
items.source_title: The Penrose inequality for maximal asymptotically hyperbolic initial data
items.source_abstract: We prove the sharp Penrose inequality for three-dimensional maximal asymptotically hyperbolic initial data with spherical conformal infinity. Under the dominant energy condition, the stated decay and integrability assumptions, and a future-timelike mass covector, the invariant mass is bounded below by the Schwarzschild–anti-de Sitter mass associated with the minimum enclosing area of a weakly future outer-trapped boundary. The boundary may be disconnected, and no restriction is imposed on the compact topology.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 素数前项的 Poisson–Dirichlet 律
items.explanation_zh: 研究 p−1 的素因子大小分布。
items.source_title: The Poisson-Dirichlet law for prime predecessors
items.source_abstract: For a prime p chosen uniformly from $`3\le p\le x`$, list the prime factors of $`p-1`$ in decreasing order, with multiplicity. As $`x\to\infty`$, their logarithms, divided by $`\log(p-1)`$, converge in every finite joint distribution to the Poisson–Dirichlet distribution with parameter one. This proves the conjecture of Ford, Konyagin and Luca.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 准 Riemann 假设的 11/12 证明
items.explanation_zh: 研究 Dirichlet L 函数的无零点半平面。
items.source_title: The Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis (alternate 11/12 proof)
items.source_abstract: We establish the quasi-Riemann hypothesis by proving that every Dirichlet L-function, including Riemann's zeta function, has no zeros in the half-plane $`\mathop{\mathrm{Re}}\nolimits s\gt 11/12`$. More generally, we prove the same zero-free half-plane for every finite-order Hecke L-function over $`K=\mathbb Q(\sqrt{-3})`$. In particular, this rules out the existence of Landau–Siegel zeros.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 准 Riemann 假设的 7/8 区域
items.explanation_zh: 研究 Hecke 与 Dirichlet L 函数的零点范围。
items.source_title: The Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis: A Zero-Free Half-Plane $`\Re s\gt 7/8`$
items.source_abstract: We prove that all finite-order Hecke L-functions over $`\mathbb Q(\sqrt{-3})`$ and all Dirichlet L-functions are zero-free in the half-plane $`\Re s\gt 7/8`$, with the principal pole at s = 1 allowed. In particular, the Riemann zeta function is zero-free in this half-plane, proving the quasi-Riemann hypothesis.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 铁磁四状态 Potts 重建阈值
items.explanation_zh: 判断沿树广播的四状态信息何时可恢复。
items.source_title: The Reconstruction Threshold for the Ferromagnetic Four-State Potts Model
items.source_abstract: We establish the exact Kesten–Stigum reconstruction threshold for the ferromagnetic four-state Potts broadcast model on every regular d-ary tree with d ≥ 2 and every Poisson Galton–Watson tree of mean d > 0. Reconstruction occurs exactly when $`d\lambda^2\gt 1`$; we prove nonreconstruction at and below the threshold, including equality. In the Poisson model the whole tree is observed and the reconstruction advantage is averaged without conditioning on survival. The proof uses reproducible exact-arithmetic verification of polynomial inequalities.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 正特征的受限几何 Langlands 等价
items.explanation_zh: 研究光滑射影曲线上的受限范畴对应。
items.source_title: The Restricted Geometric Langlands Equivalence in Positive Characteristic
items.source_abstract: We prove the $`\overline{\mathbb Q}_\ell`$-linear restricted geometric Langlands equivalence for smooth projective connected curves and connected reductive groups in characteristic p > 0, with ℓ ≠ p, in two regimes. Over $`\overline{\mathbb F}_q`$, we assume the four characteristic conditions of the restricted theory stated below. Over arbitrary algebraically closed fields, we assume these conditions and additionally that p is very good and does not divide the Weyl-group order. This proves Gaitsgory–Raskin's full-support conjecture [[12, Conjecture 1.3.10]](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.02237v1) in these regimes.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 每个素数处的 Selmer 逆命题
items.explanation_zh: 研究余秩零或一与椭圆曲线解析秩的关系。
items.source_title: The Selmer converse for elliptic curves at every prime
items.source_abstract: We prove the Selmer converse in coranks zero and one for every elliptic curve over ℚ and every prime p: if the full p-power Selmer group has ℤp-corank $`r\in\{0,1\}`$, then the analytic and Mordell–Weil ranks both equal r, and the entire Tate–Shafarevich group is finite. As an application at the additive prime 3, we prove that for every prime $`\ell\equiv4,7,8\pmod9`$, the cubic $`X^3+Y^3=\ell Z^3`$ has analytic and Mordell–Weil rank one and finite Tate–Shafarevich group. In particular, every such ℓ is a sum of two rational cubes.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: r(5,t) 的尖锐对数指数
items.explanation_zh: 精细估计五阶完全图的非对角 Ramsey 数。
items.source_title: The sharp logarithmic exponent of r(5,t)
items.source_abstract:
We determine the sharp logarithmic exponent of the off-diagonal Ramsey number $`r(5,t)`$:

$`\displaystyle r(5,t)=\frac{t^4}{(\log t)^{3+o(1)}} \qquad (t\longrightarrow\infty).`$
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 随机删三角形的最终余图
items.explanation_zh: 研究不断删除随机三角形后剩余的边数。
items.source_title: The sharp terminal leave in random triangle removal
items.source_abstract: Starting from the complete graph on n vertices, repeatedly remove the three edges of a uniformly chosen remaining triangle. We prove that the number of edges left at termination, divided by n3/2, converges in L2 to $`1/(2\sqrt2)`$. This proves the triangle case of the sharp-constant conjecture of Joos and Kühn. In particular, the same limit holds in probability and for the normalized expectation.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 四维 Singer 猜想
items.explanation_zh: 研究无高阶同伦四维流形的 L² Betti 数。
items.source_title: The Singer conjecture in dimension four
items.source_abstract: We prove the four-dimensional Singer conjecture: the L2-Betti numbers of the universal cover of a closed connected aspherical topological four-manifold vanish outside degree two. More generally, the same vanishing holds for finite connected aspherical integral Poincaré complexes of formal dimension four, including nonorientable ones.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 极小超曲面的最小体积
items.explanation_zh: 比较球面中极小超曲面的体积下界。
items.source_title: The Solomon–Yau least-volume theorem
items.source_abstract: We prove the Solomon–Yau least-volume conjecture for minimal hypersurfaces of unit round spheres: in every dimension m ≥ 2, a closed connected minimal immersion with non-totally-geodesic image has volume at least the smallest m-dimensional minimal Clifford product. Volume is measured on the domain, so covering multiplicities are included.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 素数二处球面的稳定 Hurewicz 像
items.explanation_zh: 研究稳定同伦类进入模二同调后的像。
items.source_title: The Stable Hurewicz Image of the Sphere at Two
items.source_abstract: We prove Curtis's conjecture: in every positive degree, the mod-two stable Hurewicz image of the sphere is spanned by the images of η, ν, σ and the Kervaire-invariant-one classes that exist. Consequently, Eccles's conjecture holds for every sphere Sn with n > 0.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 强超 Kähler SYZ 猜想
items.explanation_zh: 研究各向同性线丛与拉格朗日纤维化。
items.source_title: The strong hyperkähler SYZ conjecture
items.source_abstract: We prove the strong hyperkähler SYZ conjecture: every holomorphic line bundle with nonzero nef isotropic first Chern class on a compact irreducible holomorphic symplectic Kähler manifold is semiample.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 亚临界 Hénon–Lane–Emden 系统
items.explanation_zh: 研究非线性椭圆系统的正解是否存在。
items.source_title: The Subcritical Hénon–Lane–Emden Conjecture
items.source_abstract: We prove the subcritical Hénon–Lane–Emden conjecture: for every dimension n ≥ 2, positive powers p, q, and real weights A, B, the system has no strictly positive entire solution when $`(n+A)/(p+1)+(n+B)/(q+1)\gt n-2`$. Solutions need only be continuous at the origin and classical elsewhere, without a condition at infinity. For n ≥ 3 and $`A,B\gt -2`$, combining this result with the radial existence theorem of Bidaut-Véron and Giacomini proves Phan's Conjecture C in full: a positive radial entire solution exists whenever the strict inequality fails.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 唯一博弈问题
items.explanation_zh: 研究近乎可满足约束系统的计算难度。
items.source_title: The Unique Games Theorem
items.source_abstract: We prove the Unique Games Conjecture. For every fixed $`\varepsilon,\delta\in(0,1/2)`$, we give a deterministic polynomial-time reduction from 3SAT to Unique Games over a fixed finite alphabet, with completeness at least $`1-\varepsilon`$ and soundness at most δ.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 特殊紧 Kähler 空间的交换性
items.explanation_zh: 研究基本群是否含有限指数的交换子群。
items.source_title: The abelianity conjecture for special compact Kähler manifolds
items.source_abstract: We prove that the fundamental group of every special compact Kähler manifold is virtually abelian, resolving Campana's abelianity conjecture in all dimensions. In particular, every smooth compact connected Kähler manifold of Kodaira dimension zero has virtually abelian ordinary fundamental group.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 三至九维仿射 Bernstein 定理
items.explanation_zh: 研究完整凸仿射极大图的形状刚性。
items.source_title: The affine Bernstein theorem in dimensions three through nine
items.source_abstract: We prove the Euclidean-complete affine Bernstein conjecture in dimensions three through nine: a smooth locally uniformly convex affine maximal graph is an elliptic paraboloid whenever its induced Euclidean metric is complete. The same conclusion holds, without an initial graph assumption, for connected smooth open (noncompact and without boundary) affine-complete locally uniformly convex immersed hypersurfaces that are classically affine maximal in these dimensions.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 算术范畴与格点因子的稳定恢复
items.explanation_zh: 从扭曲群因子的同构恢复群与余循环。
items.source_title: The arithmetic category and stable recovery of lattice factors
items.source_abstract: We prove stable canonical recovery for scalar-twisted group factors of ICC groups commensurable with property-$`(T)`$ lattices over characteristic-zero local fields. Every specified stable isomorphism to a scalar-twisted factor of any countably infinite ICC group recovers the group, the cocycle up to a normalized cochain, and equal amplification scales, with an implementing partial isometry in the given matrix corners. We compute the arithmetic correspondence subcategory for arbitrary countable ICC groups, including all bounded maps, summands, conjugates, and Connes fusion, and combine it with the companion's arithmetic exhaustion theorem. Multiplication also recovers arbitrary finite-index factor neighbors, with the exact projective condition on the matched cocycle ratio.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 二维自旋模型的连续极限
items.explanation_zh: 把格点上的自旋模型过渡到连续空间。
items.source_title: The canonical massive continuum limit of the two-dimensional O(3) model
items.source_abstract: We construct a canonical interacting massive continuum limit of the two-dimensional nearest-neighbor $`O(3)`$ model with unit-length spins, no external field, and no topological term. Normalized by susceptibility and second-moment correlation length, the limit exists as the bare coupling tends to infinity through all positive real values, without selecting subsequences. The limiting fields satisfy the Osterwalder–Schrader axioms and have a nonzero connected four-point correlation on separated time supports. Their reconstructed theory has a unique vacuum, a nonzero vacuum complement, and a positive Hamiltonian gap on that entire complement.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 循环哈达玛矩阵
items.explanation_zh: 研究只有 ±1 的循环正交矩阵能有多大。
items.source_title: The circulant Hadamard conjecture
items.source_abstract: We prove the circulant Hadamard conjecture: a real circulant Hadamard matrix has order 1 or 4. As a consequence, Barker sequences of length greater than one exist exactly at lengths 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 11, 13, proving the Barker-sequence conjecture.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 矩阵函数的大小界限
items.explanation_zh: 用数值域控制多项式作用后的矩阵大小。
items.source_title: The complete Crouzeix theorem: optimal similarity and a common positive boundary representation
items.source_abstract: We resolve the complete Crouzeix conjecture by proving the sharp constant-two numerical-range inequality for every bounded operator on a complex Hilbert space and every matrix-valued polynomial. No separability assumption is needed. The closure of the numerical range is a complete 2-spectral set, and the bound extends to finite matrix-valued functions holomorphic near that closure. For a finite matrix and a bounded convex domain containing its numerical range with regular real-analytic Jordan boundary, the optimal similarity making its conformal disk image contractive is attained with condition number at most two. For the similar matrix, one continuous positive boundary density of mass the identity represents the evaluation of every matrix-valued function holomorphic near the closed domain.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 识别图结构的计算难度
items.explanation_zh: 判断细化算法能否唯一识别一张图。
items.source_title: The complexity of identifying a graph by Weisfeiler–Leman refinement
items.source_abstract: We prove that deciding whether Weisfeiler–Leman refinement of an input dimension identifies a given graph is EXPTIME-complete. The input is a nonempty finite simple uncolored graph in adjacency-matrix form and a positive binary-encoded dimension. Identification quantifies over every comparison graph.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 空间与对偶空间的几何
items.explanation_zh: 联系两类空间中随机符号组合的性质。
items.source_title: The cotype–cotype conjecture under the approximation property
items.source_abstract: We prove the cotype–cotype conjecture under the ordinary approximation property. A nonzero real Banach space with this property is K-convex if and only if both the space and its dual have finite Rademacher cotype, possibly with different exponents.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 随机曲面的连续极限
items.explanation_zh: 把临界随机平面图缩放到随机量子球面。
items.source_title: The critical Liouville quantum sphere and geometric limits of FK maps at q=4
items.source_abstract: We construct the field and area law of the unit-area critical Liouville quantum sphere as a limit of ordinary subcritical quantum spheres, and equip it with its critical intrinsic metric. We then prove that spherical Fortuin–Kasteleyn planar maps at q = 4, embedded by their equilateral flag uniformizations, converge jointly to this sphere decorated by an independent nested conformal loop ensemble CLE4. With deterministic distance normalization, the convergence includes the area measure, the full embedded distance function, and every macroscopic interface through all positive integer edge counts.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 临界点的自旋关联
items.explanation_zh: 研究 XY 模型中关联随距离衰减的速度。
items.source_title: The critical correlation exponent of the planar XY model
items.source_abstract: For the ordinary nearest-neighbor XY model on the square lattice, we prove the Berezinskii–Kosterlitz–Thouless prediction that the critical spin-correlation exponent is 1/4. More precisely, at the mass-defined critical inverse temperature, the infinite-volume correlation is $`n^{-1/4+o(1)}`$. The infinite-volume limit through free square boxes is taken before the separation limit.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 自由边界何时出现奇点
items.explanation_zh: 研究自由边界在七维出现奇点的临界情况。
items.source_title: The critical dimension for one-phase Bernoulli minimizers
items.source_abstract: We prove that seven is the critical dimension for the one-phase Bernoulli problem: every nonzero one-homogeneous global minimizer in dimensions at most six is flat, while a nonflat one-homogeneous global minimizer exists in dimension seven. It follows that the interior free boundary of a local minimizer is smooth in dimensions at most six. In dimension n ≥ 7, its singular set has Hausdorff dimension at most $`n-7`$, and this bound is sharp. In dimension seven, the singular set is locally finite.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 临界关联的精细修正
items.explanation_zh: 刻画 XY 模型幂律衰减中的对数修正。
items.source_title: The critical logarithmic correction for the planar XY model
items.source_abstract:
We prove the critical logarithmic correction for the nearest-neighbor cosine XY model on the square lattice. Let $`C_{b_c}(r)`$ be the two-point correlation at critical inverse temperature, obtained by taking the free-box thermodynamic limit while the two sites remain r lattice steps apart along a coordinate axis. Then

$`\displaystyle C_{b_c}(r)=B_{\mathrm{XY}}r^{-1/4}(\log r)^{1/8}(1+o(1)), \qquad B_{\mathrm{XY}}\in(0,\infty),`$

as $`r\to\infty`$.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 两组连线的最少交叉
items.explanation_zh: 研究完全二部图至少产生多少处交叉。
items.source_title: The crossing number of complete bipartite graphs
items.source_abstract:
We prove the Zarankiewicz crossing-number conjecture, resolving Turán's brickyard problem. For all positive integers m, n, the ordinary crossing number of the complete bipartite graph $`K_{m,n}`$ is

$`\displaystyle \left\lfloor\frac m2\right\rfloor \left\lfloor\frac{m-1}{2}\right\rfloor \left\lfloor\frac n2\right\rfloor \left\lfloor\frac{n-1}{2}\right\rfloor.`$
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 所有点互连的最少交叉
items.explanation_zh: 研究完全图在平面上最少产生多少交叉。
items.source_title: The crossing number of complete graphs
items.source_abstract:
We prove the Harary–Hill conjecture: for every positive integer n, the ordinary crossing number of the complete graph Kn is

$`\displaystyle \frac14\left\lfloor\frac n2\right\rfloor \left\lfloor\frac{n-1}{2}\right\rfloor \left\lfloor\frac{n-2}{2}\right\rfloor \left\lfloor\frac{n-3}{2}\right\rfloor.`$
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 随机闭合曲线的极限
items.explanation_zh: 研究双二聚体的环在网格变细后的极限。
items.source_title: The curve scaling limit of half-plane double dimers
items.source_abstract: We prove that the complete double-dimer loop ensemble for the Temperleyan square lattice in the upper half-plane converges to nested CLE4. The convergence holds along the full mesh limit and matches every macroscopic loop as an unparametrized curve. This resolves the half-plane Temperleyan form of the double-dimer CLE4 scaling-limit conjecture.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 避开固定比例的点列
items.explanation_zh: 构造大集合，避开二进点列的相似副本。
items.source_title: The dyadic case of the Erdős similarity conjecture
items.source_abstract: We construct a compact subset of the unit interval, of measure arbitrarily close to one, that contains no affine copy of the dyadic sequence $`\{2^{-n}:n\ge1\}`$. The conclusion holds for every translation and every nonzero real dilation, of either sign, proving the dyadic case of the Erdős similarity conjecture.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 量子通信的熵界限
items.explanation_zh: 研究玻色输入混合后的熵与通信容量。
items.source_title: The entropy photon-number inequality
items.source_abstract: We prove the entropy photon-number inequality for two independent bosonic inputs with finite mean energy, for every finite number of modes. This resolves the entropy photon-number conjecture in this finite-energy setting while allowing arbitrary entanglement among the modes within either input. As a consequence, we determine the exact minimum output entropy at fixed input entropy for every finite tensor power of an identical thermal attenuator, over finite-energy inputs that may be entangled across modes. We also obtain the exact classical capacity region of the degraded two-receiver pure-loss bosonic broadcast channel under a mean photon constraint.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 分形测度的维数
items.explanation_zh: 用随机过程的信息量刻画自相似测度维数。
items.source_title: The entropy-rate dimension formula for self-similar measures on the line
items.source_abstract: We prove that the Hausdorff dimension of every finite real self-similar measure equals the minimum of one and its random-walk entropy rate divided by its Lyapunov exponent. Exact overlaps are allowed, and the contraction ratios may be unequal and negative. This resolves the entropy-rate dimension conjecture.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 两种几何结构的对应
items.explanation_zh: 联系箭图空间的上同调与另一空间的固定点。
items.source_title: The equivariant cohomological Hikita conjecture for arbitrary quivers
items.source_abstract: We prove the equivariant cohomological Hikita conjecture for arbitrary finite quivers, including loops and multiple arrows. For any dimension and framing vectors, any commuting flavor torus, and a stability character whose semistable locus is stable and has free gauge action, the equivariant cohomology of the Nakajima variety is canonically isomorphic to the coordinate ring of the scheme-theoretic fixed locus of the stability cocharacter on the flavor-deformed Coulomb branch. This is an isomorphism of graded algebras over the common coefficient ring, retaining nilpotents and including the empty case.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 噪声中恢复三类信号
items.explanation_zh: 确定树上传播的三状态信号何时能被重建。
items.source_title: The exact reconstruction threshold for the three-state symmetric channel
items.source_abstract: We determine the exact reconstruction threshold for the symmetric three-state broadcast process on every regular b-ary tree, b ≥ 2, and every observed Poisson Galton–Watson tree of mean d > 1. Reconstruction occurs exactly when $`d\lambda^2\gt 1`$, with d = b in the regular model; there is non-reconstruction at equality for either sign of the channel parameter. The Poisson advantage is averaged over trees and spins without conditioning on survival. This resolves the all-degree three-state regular-tree prediction. Combining the Poisson theorem with known tree-to-graph and algorithmic results gives the exact weak-recovery threshold for the symmetric three-community sparse stochastic block model with independent uniform labels, fixed within- and between-community rates $`a,b\gt 0`$, and mean degree $`(a+2b)/3\gt 1`$: recovery is possible exactly when $`(a-b)^2\gt 3(a+2b)`$. Above this threshold it is achievable in $`O(n\log n)`$ time; at or below it, weak recovery is information-theoretically impossible.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 低温磁化的晶格修正
items.explanation_zh: 计算铁磁体低温磁化规律中的下一项修正。
items.source_title: The first lattice correction to Bloch's law
items.source_abstract: We prove the first lattice correction to Bloch's law for the three-dimensional nearest-neighbor quantum Heisenberg ferromagnet at every fixed spin $`S=\tfrac12,1,\tfrac32,\ldots`$. The spontaneous-magnetization deficit agrees with the full ideal-magnon density up to $`o(\beta^{-5/2})`$. In addition to the leading Bloch term, this gives the correction $`3\zeta(5/2)(\beta S)^{-5/2}/(128\pi^{3/2})`$. The magnetization is the right derivative at zero field of the thermodynamic pressure; the volume limit precedes the field derivative, and the low-temperature limit is taken last.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 离散感知机的自由能
items.explanation_zh: 计算随机输入下二值感知机的极限自由能。
items.source_title: The free energy of the Ising random perceptron
items.source_abstract: We determine the limiting free energy of the Ising perceptron with independent Gaussian patterns for every bounded Borel log-potential, at every fixed positive temperature and pattern density. We give an explicit variational formula for the limit and prove convergence in expectation and probability.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 球面感知机的自由能
items.explanation_zh: 计算球面约束感知机的极限自由能。
items.source_title: The free energy of the spherical random perceptron
items.source_abstract: We prove an exact variational formula for the limiting pressure of the spherical random perceptron with an arbitrary bounded continuous single-pattern potential. The formula holds at every fixed positive density and inverse temperature, with convergence in expectation and in probability.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 从独立随机量生成森林
items.explanation_zh: 用统一规则在无限图上生成随机生成森林。
items.source_title: The free uniform spanning forest is a factor of IID
items.source_abstract: We prove that the free uniform spanning forest is a factor of IID on every infinite connected locally finite simple unweighted graph. One Borel rule works for all such graphs and uses no root, answering affirmatively the general factor question for unimodular random graphs. We also show that every translation-invariant strongly Rayleigh process indexed by a countable group is a factor of IID, including invariant determinantal processes with Hermitian positive-contraction kernels. This group-action conclusion requires no amenability.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 避开等比数列的相似副本
items.explanation_zh: 针对固定比例，构造没有对应点列的大集合。
items.source_title: The geometric case of the Erdős similarity conjecture
items.source_abstract: We prove the geometric-progression case of the Erdős similarity conjecture. For every fixed $`q\in(0,1)`$ and every $`\eta\in(0,1)`$, we construct a compact set $`E_{q,\eta}\subseteq[0,1]`$ of measure greater than $`1-\eta`$ containing no nontrivial affine copy of $`\{q^n:n\ge1\}`$, for any translation and either sign of nonzero dilation. The set may depend on q; the result makes no simultaneous assertion for different ratios.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 稳定同伦中的分层结构
items.explanation_zh: 把高度三的球面谱重叠拆成八层结构。
items.source_title: The height-three chromatic overlap: an explicit filtration and its attachments
items.source_abstract: For every prime p ≥ 5, we construct an explicit eight-stage filtration of $`L_2L_{K(3)}\mathbb S_p^\wedge`$ by the local-sphere layers in the height-three chromatic-splitting pattern. The map from its first stage to the overlap is the canonical unit, and two signed fracture formulas identify all attachments for the chosen local maps and compatibility homotopy. A companion canonical-map theorem further implies that the first height-one attachment is nonzero.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 高维点集的不同距离
items.explanation_zh: 研究高维点集至少产生多少种不同距离。
items.source_title: The higher-dimensional Erdős distinct-distances conjecture
items.source_abstract: For every fixed integer d ≥ 3, we prove that every set of n ≥ 2 distinct points in ℝd determines at least $`c_d n^{2/d}`$ distinct distances, where $`c_d\gt 0`$ depends only on d. This resolves the higher-dimensional Erdős distinct-distances conjecture positively.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 染色图中的超立方体
items.explanation_zh: 研究必然出现单色超立方体所需的图规模。
items.source_title: The hypercube Ramsey number has linear order
items.source_abstract: We prove that the two-color Ramsey number of the n-dimensional binary cube is at most $`C2^n`$, where C is an absolute constant. This resolves positively the hypercube Ramsey conjecture of Burr and Erdős.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 分数能多精确地逼近 π
items.explanation_zh: 研究用有理数逼近圆周率的精度极限。
items.source_title: The irrationality exponent of pi is 2
items.source_abstract: We prove the conjecture that the irrationality exponent of π is 2. As a consequence, the classical Flint–Hills series $`\sum_{n\ge1}1/(n^3\sin^2 n)`$ converges, with angles in radians.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 相邻整数的最大质因子
items.explanation_zh: 研究两数的最大质因子是否渐近独立。
items.source_title: The joint Dickman law for consecutive integers
items.source_abstract: Let $`P^+(n)`$ denote the largest prime factor of n. We prove that $`\log P^+(n)/\log n`$ and $`\log P^+(n+1)/\log n`$ are asymptotically independent in ordinary natural density, with Dickman marginals. This resolves the Erdős–Pomerance joint Dickman conjecture positively and implies that the ordering $`P^+(n)\lt P^+(n+1)`$ has natural density 1/2.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 临界模型的联合缩放
items.explanation_zh: 研究高度场与随机簇缩放后的共同极限。
items.source_title: The joint scaling limit of critical Ashkin-Teller currents
items.source_abstract: For each fixed point on the critical Ashkin–Teller line, including the four-state Potts endpoint, we prove the conjectured joint scaling limit of the height and both current-cluster collections in every bounded Jordan domain, for every admissible polygonal approximation. The height converges to a Gaussian free field with the predicted coupling constant, and the clusters converge to canonical recursive two-valued local sets of that same field. The joint limit includes all nesting depths and the distinguished wired boundary cluster.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 离散群的 ℓ¹-Bass 猜想
items.explanation_zh: 研究完备群代数幂等矩阵的 Hattori–Stallings 迹。
items.source_title: The ℓ¹-Bass Conjecture for Discrete Groups
items.source_abstract: We prove the ℓ1-Bass conjecture for every discrete group. The Hattori–Stallings trace of every idempotent matrix over the complex ℓ1 group algebra is supported on finitely many conjugacy classes of finite-order elements.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 对数 Brunn–Minkowski 猜想
items.explanation_zh: 研究原点对称凸体对数插值的体积关系。
items.source_title: The logarithmic Brunn–Minkowski conjecture
items.source_abstract: We prove the logarithmic Brunn–Minkowski conjecture for arbitrary origin-symmetric convex bodies in every dimension. The theorem also gives the symmetric Lp Brunn–Minkowski inequality for every $`0\lt p\lt 1`$. Combined with Saroglou's transfer theorem and a support-subspace reduction, it yields the logarithmic inequality for every even log-concave Radon measure and the scalar-dilation $`(B)`$-conjecture.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 低温 SK 模型的涨落尺度
items.explanation_zh: 估计自旋玻璃自由能标准差的增长量级。
items.source_title: The low-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick fluctuation scale
items.source_abstract: For the zero-field Gaussian Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model at every fixed inverse temperature β > 1, we prove that the standard deviation of the log partition function is $`n^{1/6+o(1)}`$. The same exponent describes its typical centered absolute fluctuations, establishing the predicted one-sixth exponent in this regime.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 低温 SK 自由能的极限分布
items.explanation_zh: 研究热力学极限下自由能涨落的概率规律。
items.source_title: The low-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick free-energy limiting law
items.source_abstract: For every fixed inverse temperature β > 1, we prove that the zero-field Gaussian Ising Sherrington–Kirkpatrick free energy, centered by its expectation and divided by its standard deviation, converges in distribution to a nondegenerate law as the system size tends to infinity through all integers. We also prove that its variance divided by n1/3 converges to a finite positive constant.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 对称点的极大三角 Hilbert 变换
items.explanation_zh: 控制任意复值输入的逐点最大奇异积分。
items.source_title: The maximal triangular Hilbert transform at the symmetric point
items.source_abstract: For arbitrary complex inputs in $`L^3(\mathbb R^2)`$, we prove the pointwise maximal $`L^3\times L^3\to L^{3/2}`$ estimate for the triangular Hilbert transform, with the supremum over both hard truncation endpoints. The estimate yields joint almost-everywhere and L3/2 convergence as the lower endpoint tends to zero and the upper endpoint tends to infinity. This also proves the conjectured scalar estimate at the symmetric point.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 六维互无偏基的最大数量
items.explanation_zh: 研究量子测量中互无偏正交基能有多少组。
items.source_title: The maximum number of mutually unbiased bases in dimension six
items.source_abstract: We prove that the maximum number of mutually unbiased orthonormal bases in ℂ6 is three, resolving Zauner's dimension-six MUB conjecture. The upper bound is computer-assisted: under the stated binary64 arithmetic and compiler conditions, a complete execution of the documented verification pipeline excludes four arbitrary complex bases.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 椭圆曲线二次扭转的平均解析秩
items.explanation_zh: 研究按判别数增长时秩的平均值。
items.source_title: The mean analytic rank of quadratic twists of elliptic curves
items.source_abstract: For every elliptic curve over ℚ, we prove that the average analytic rank of its quadratic twists tends to 1/2 when signed squarefree twist parameters are ordered by absolute value. This resolves Goldfeld's mean analytic-rank conjecture in this counting convention.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 度量 Blaschke 猜想
items.explanation_zh: 研究全局注入半径与直径相同的闭流形。
items.source_title: The metric Blaschke theorem
items.source_abstract: We prove the metric Blaschke conjecture: every connected closed smooth Riemannian manifold of positive dimension whose global injectivity radius equals its diameter is, up to scale, a standard compact rank-one symmetric space.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 非极大反德西特 Penrose 不等式
items.explanation_zh: 研究初值质量、边界面积与原数据刚性。
items.source_title: The nonmaximal anti-de Sitter Penrose Inequality and original-data rigidity
items.source_abstract: We prove the spacetime Penrose Inequality for smooth three-dimensional initial-data exteriors with one spherical asymptotically anti-de Sitter end, satisfying the stated decay and integrability assumptions, the dominant energy condition, and a compact weakly future outer trapped boundary. We assume that the hyperbolic metric four-flux is future timelike; its Lorentz norm is the mass, and the area is the infimum over full enclosing cuts. On the connected outermost, outer area-minimizing horizon subclass, equality characterizes the original data as a spacelike hypersurface in Schwarzschild–anti-de Sitter spacetime with matching metric mass. No maximality, evolution, or auxiliary solvability assumption is used.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 四维归一化体积的差距
items.explanation_zh: 估计四维 klt 奇点的归一化体积上限。
items.source_title: The normalized-volume gap in dimension four
items.source_abstract: We prove that every singular complex algebraic klt fourfold germ with zero boundary has normalized volume at most 162, with equality precisely for an analytic ordinary double point. This resolves the ordinary-double-point volume-gap conjecture in dimension four.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 普通二重点的体积差距
items.explanation_zh: 比较光滑点与奇异点的归一化体积。
items.source_title: The ordinary-double-point gap in every dimension
items.source_abstract: We prove the ordinary-double-point gap conjecture for boundary-zero complex algebraic klt germs in every dimension: a singular n-dimensional germ has normalized volume at most $`2(n-1)^n`$, with equality precisely at an analytic ordinary double point.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: p 进截面猜想
items.explanation_zh: 研究高亏格曲线的有理点与基本群截面。
items.source_title: The p-adic section conjecture
items.source_abstract: We prove the local p-adic section conjecture for smooth proper geometrically connected curves of genus at least two, over every finite extension of ℚp. Combined with established finite-descent theorems, this also yields the global section conjecture for smooth proper geometrically connected curves of genus at least two over number fields when their finite-cover descent locus equals their rational points; this includes $`X_0(N)`$ and $`X_1(N)`$ of genus at least two over ℚ.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 周期自旋一链的 Haldane 能隙
items.explanation_zh: 研究偶数环上反铁磁 Heisenberg 链的能隙。
items.source_title: The periodic spin-one Haldane gap
items.source_abstract: We prove a uniform positive spectral gap for the pure antiferromagnetic spin-one Heisenberg chain on even periodic rings, establishing the positive even-periodic formulation of the spin-one Haldane conjecture.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: CM 阿贝尔簇的有理 Hodge 猜想
items.explanation_zh: 研究复乘阿贝尔簇的 Hodge 类能否代数化。
items.source_title: The rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties
items.source_abstract: We prove the rational Hodge conjecture for complex abelian varieties with complex multiplication: every rational Hodge class on such a variety is a rational linear combination of algebraic cycle classes. As consequences, we obtain the generalized Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties, the Tate conjecture for abelian varieties over finite fields, and the Hodge standard conjecture for abelian varieties in arbitrary characteristic.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: K3 曲面乘积的 Hodge 类
items.explanation_zh: 研究有限乘积上的有理类与代数循环。
items.source_title: The rational Hodge conjecture for products of K3 surfaces
items.source_abstract: We prove the rational Hodge conjecture for every finite product of projective complex K3 surfaces: every rational Hodge class is algebraic. The factors may be distinct or repeated, with no restrictions on their Picard numbers, periods, or endomorphism fields.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 反向对数 Kodaira 不等式
items.explanation_zh: 研究连通纤维态射中的维数加法关系。
items.source_title: The reverse logarithmic Kodaira inequality and additivity
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 第二 Kahn–Kalai 猜想
items.explanation_zh: 比较随机图出现指定子图的阈值。
items.source_title: The second Kahn–Kalai conjecture
items.source_abstract: We prove the second Kahn–Kalai conjecture. For every finite simple graph H with h ≥ 1 edges and at most n vertices, the threshold for $`G(n,p)`$ to contain an ordinary copy of H is at most $`C p_{\mathrm E}(n,H)(1+\log_2 h)`$, where C is universal. Here $`p_{\mathrm E}(n,H)`$ is the least density at which every subgraph of H has expected copy count at least one half.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 对称 Bernoulli 矩阵的奇异概率
items.explanation_zh: 研究随机正负一矩阵不可逆的指数概率。
items.source_title: The sharp exponential rate of singularity for symmetric Bernoulli matrices
items.source_abstract:
Let An be a symmetric $`n\times n`$ matrix whose entries on and above the diagonal are independent uniform signs. We prove

$`\displaystyle \Pr(\det A_n=0)=\left(\frac12+o(1)\right)^n.`$
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 树上自由 Ising 的 IID 因子阈值
items.explanation_zh: 研究自旋分布能否由独立随机标签生成。
items.source_title: The sharp factor-of-IID threshold for the free Ising model on regular trees
items.source_abstract: For every integer d ≥ 3 and inverse temperature β ≥ 0, the free zero-field ferromagnetic Ising measure on the infinite d-regular tree is a factor of IID exactly when $`\tanh\beta\le(d-1)^{-1/2}`$. We prove the positive implication, including equality, resolving the conjecture of Nam, Sly and Zhang; the strict converse is known. The spin factor can be chosen to commute with every tree automorphism on every label input.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 偏置对称符号矩阵的奇异率
items.explanation_zh: 估计正负一概率不等时矩阵不可逆的概率。
items.source_title: The sharp singularity rate for biased symmetric sign matrices
items.source_abstract: Let An be a symmetric random matrix whose entries on and above the diagonal are independent signs, equal to 1 with fixed probability $`p\in(0,1)\setminus\{1/2\}`$. We prove that $`\mathbb P(\det A_n=0)=(p^2+(1-p)^2+o(1))^n`$. The rate is attained by the event that two rows agree.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 时空 Penrose 不等式与包围面积
items.explanation_zh: 联系高维初值外部的质量与最小包围面积。
items.source_title: The spacetime Penrose inequality and enclosing area
items.source_abstract: We prove the sharp spacetime Penrose inequality for smooth one-ended initial-data exteriors in every spatial dimension n ≥ 3, under the dominant energy condition, weak future trapping, the stated differentiated decay and positive enclosing area. These hypotheses force the ADM energy-momentum to be future timelike. Area is the infimum over full enclosing cuts in the original metric. In dimensions three and four, two metric derivatives and one tensor derivative suffice, and both positive enclosing area and future timelikeness follow from the hypotheses.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 带电 Penrose 界与初值刚性
items.explanation_zh: 在能量与衰减条件下联系质量、电荷和面积。
items.source_title: The spacetime Penrose inequality with charge and original-data rigidity
items.source_abstract: Under the stated energy, decay, and trapping hypotheses, we prove the sharp charged spacetime Penrose upper-area inequality for one-ended three-dimensional initial data with source-free electric and magnetic fields. The theorem allows arbitrary second fundamental form, nonzero ADM momentum, and disconnected boundary. Writing m for invariant ADM mass, Q for total charge magnitude, and rA for the minimum-enclosing-area radius, the bound is m ≥ Q and $`r_A\le m+\sqrt{m^2-Q^2}`$. The polynomial mass bound $`m\ge(r_A+Q^2/r_A)/2`$ is asserted only when $`r_A\gt Q`$. When m > Q, equality under the stated connected, outermost, outer-area-minimizing future-horizon hypotheses identifies the original data as a smooth spacelike slice of dyonic Reissner–Nordström, including smooth attachment at the future horizon.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 三维量子铁磁体的球面磁化律
items.explanation_zh: 研究各向同性 Heisenberg 模型的磁化分布。
items.source_title: The spherical magnetization law for the three-dimensional quantum Heisenberg ferromagnet
items.source_abstract: We prove the spherical magnetization law for the three-dimensional nearest-neighbor isotropic quantum Heisenberg ferromagnet at every fixed positive quantum spin and every sufficiently low fixed positive temperature. As the even periodic cubes grow, the symmetric zero-field magnetization converges in moments to a uniform direction with a deterministic positive magnitude. This magnitude equals the right derivative at zero field of the infinite-volume pressure. The law is expressed through self-adjoint linear combinations of the spin components and requires no joint measurement of noncommuting observables.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 双正交不变无序的球面感知机
items.explanation_zh: 计算随机感知机模型的极限自由能。
items.source_title: The spherical perceptron with bi-orthogonally invariant disorder
items.source_abstract: We determine the limiting free energy of a spherical perceptron with a bounded continuous activation and a bi-orthogonally invariant disorder matrix. The singular values may have any compact limiting distribution, provided there are no outliers. We give an explicit variational formula for this limit.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 强薄生成树猜想
items.explanation_zh: 寻找穿过每个割集的边数都较少的生成树。
items.source_title: The strong thin tree conjecture
items.source_abstract: We prove that every finite loopless k-edge-connected multigraph on at least two vertices, with k ≥ 1, has a spanning tree meeting each cut in at most $`C/k`$ times the size of the cut, where C is a universal constant. This resolves the strong thin tree conjecture.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 对称 Mahler 猜想的等式分类
items.explanation_zh: 研究对称凸体与极体的最小体积乘积。
items.source_title: The symmetric Mahler conjecture and its equality cases
items.source_abstract: We resolve the symmetric Mahler conjecture positively, including its equality classification. Every origin-symmetric convex body in ℝn has volume product at least $`4^n/n!`$, with equality exactly for invertible linear images of Hanner polytopes.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 用迹锥分类稳定化算子代数
items.explanation_zh: 研究 Razak–Jacelon 稳定化的完整不变量。
items.source_title: The trace cone classifies Razak–Jacelon stabilizations
items.source_abstract: We prove that the canonical topological cone of all extended lower-semicontinuous tracial weights determines a separable nuclear C∗-algebra after tensoring with the Razak–Jacelon algebra and the compact operators, answering Robert's trace-cone classification question positively. The isomorphism realizes the prescribed cone map, with arbitrary ideal structure and without a density assumption on the finite domains of the weights.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 低余秩椭圆曲线的二主 BSD 公式
items.explanation_zh: 研究 Selmer 余秩至多一时的二主算术因子。
items.source_title: The two-primary Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer formula in Selmer corank at most one
items.source_abstract: We prove the two-primary Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer leading-term formula for every elliptic curve over the rationals whose two-power Selmer group has corank at most one. In this range, the algebraic rank, analytic rank, and Selmer corank are equal, and the Tate–Shafarevich group is finite. Combined with the quadratic-twist Selmer distribution, this gives the exact two-primary formula for a density-one set of signed squarefree twists of each fixed curve, ordered by absolute value; the common rank is zero or one, with each value having density one half.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: SU(N) BFSS 的阈值束缚态
items.explanation_zh: 研究有限 N 矩阵量子力学的零能态结构。
items.source_title: The unique threshold bound state of the SU(N) BFSS model
items.source_abstract: For every finite N ≥ 2, we prove that undeformed $`\mathop{\mathrm{SU}}\nolimits (N)`$ BFSS matrix quantum mechanics has exactly one normalizable zero-energy state after removing the center of mass. This establishes the threshold-bound-state conjecture.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 弱非齐次 Duffin–Schaeffer 猜想
items.explanation_zh: 研究带固定偏移的有理数逼近。
items.source_title: The Weak Inhomogeneous Duffin–Schaeffer Conjecture
items.source_abstract: We prove the weak inhomogeneous Duffin–Schaeffer conjecture. For every fixed γ ∈ ℝ and finite-valued $`\psi:\mathbb N\to[0,\infty)`$, divergence of $`\sum_{q\ge1}\phi(q)\psi(q)/q`$ implies $`\|qx-\gamma\|\lt \psi(q)`$ for infinitely many q, for almost every x. Here ϕ is Euler's totient and $`\|\cdot\|`$ is distance to the nearest integer. Numerators need not be reduced, and the shift satisfies no Diophantine restriction.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 平面固定点距离的弱定理
items.explanation_zh: 研究从多数点出发能看到多少种不同距离。
items.source_title: The weak pinned planar distance theorem
items.source_abstract: We prove the weak pinned Erdős distinct-distance conjecture. For every fixed ε > 0, all but $`o(n)`$ points of any n-point planar set determine at least $`n^{1-\varepsilon}`$ distinct nonzero distances.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 热 FK–Ising 界面与带质量 SLE
items.explanation_zh: 研究非零质量参数下的随机界面极限。
items.source_title: Thermal FK–Ising interfaces and massive SLE
items.source_abstract: We prove convergence of thermal FK–Ising interfaces, for every fixed nonzero mass of either sign, on uniformly angle-bounded isoradial lattices in bounded simply connected domains. The limit is independent of the lattice and the admissible domain approximation. For positive mass it is the unique massive SLE$`_{16/3}`$ law with locally finite-energy drift prescribed by a massive boundary value problem; negative mass follows by duality and reversal. The theorem also allows Carathéodory approximations whose diameters diverge.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 各严格高维的 Thomason 模型结构
items.explanation_zh: 研究高阶范畴与同伦空间的模型对应。
items.source_title: Thomason Model Structures in Every Strict Higher Dimension
items.source_abstract: We prove the higher-dimensional Thomason model-structure conjecture of Ara and Maltsiniotis. For every $`1\le n\le\infty`$, the category of small strict globular n-categories admits a proper combinatorial model structure that is Quillen equivalent to simplicial sets. Its weak equivalences and fibrations are detected by the twice-extended Street nerve $`\mathrm{Ex}^2N_n`$, and the Quillen equivalence is given by $`c_n\mathrm{Sd}^2\dashv\mathrm{Ex}^2N_n`$. Thus strict higher categories model the homotopy theory of spaces in every positive finite dimension and in dimension ω.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Thompson 群 F 的非可和性
items.explanation_zh: 研究经典分段线性变换群的可和问题。
items.source_title: Thompson's group F is nonamenable
items.source_abstract: We prove that Thompson's group F is nonamenable. This confirms Geoghegan's conjecture and resolves the amenability problem for F.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 纠缠博弈的阈值并行重复
items.explanation_zh: 估计多次博弈中高比例获胜的概率衰减。
items.source_title: Threshold parallel repetition for finite-dimensional entangled games
items.source_abstract: For every finite two-player game with entangled value v < 1, we prove exponential decay for the probability of winning at least a $`v+\delta`$ fraction of k independent repetitions, uniformly over all finite-dimensional joint strategies. The result allows arbitrary correlated question distributions and holds for every $`0\lt \delta\lt 1-v`$ and k ≥ 1. Its universal rate is proportional to $`\delta^5/(1+\log(|\mathcal A||\mathcal B|))`$, where $`\mathcal A,\mathcal B`$ are the answer alphabets. For each fixed question distribution, we also obtain an explicit cubic rate in δ.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: μ 不变曲面奇点族的拓扑稳定
items.explanation_zh: 研究 Milnor 数不变时拓扑类型是否保持。
items.source_title: Topological triviality of mu-constant families of surface singularities
items.source_abstract: We prove that every holomorphic one-parameter family of isolated hypersurface singularities in ℂ3 with constant Milnor number is topologically right-trivial. This gives a positive answer to the surface case of the μ-constant problem. The trivialization fixes the parameter and the origin section, and preserves the defining functions.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 迹投影与统一 Gamma 性质
items.explanation_zh: 研究有限核算子代数的中心序列结构。
items.source_title: Tracial projection methods and uniform property Gamma
items.source_abstract: For a simple, separable, unital, infinite-dimensional, nuclear, stably finite C∗-algebra with traces, real rank zero of the uniform tracial ultrapower of its uniform tracial completion implies uniform property Γ. This answers Problem XXI of Schafhauser, Tikuisis and White affirmatively. Independently, strict comparison implies Jiang–Su absorption for simple, separable, unital, infinite-dimensional nuclear algebras, resolving the unital Toms–Winter conjecture. Under comparison tested on traces of finite target rank, we also obtain uniform property Γ and absorption for simple, separable, nuclear, stably projectionless algebras whose densely finite traces are all bounded and have a nonempty compact normalized base.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 平移覆盖的 n log n 密度
items.explanation_zh: 研究高维对称凸体覆盖密度的下界。
items.source_title: Translative covering densities of order n log n
items.source_abstract: For every sufficiently large dimension n, we construct a centrally symmetric convex body whose translative covering density exceeds $`c n\log n`$, where c > 0 is absolute. This disproves the existence of a universal linear upper bound and matches the order of Rogers' upper bound.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 二进制编辑距离的树构造
items.explanation_zh: 估计字符串距离嵌入 ℓ¹ 的扭曲下界。
items.source_title: Tree Constructions for the l1 Distortion of Binary Edit Distance
items.source_abstract: We give two independent constructions of binary words of one length at most d whose ordinary edit-distance metrics require ℓ1 distortion $`\exp(\Omega(\sqrt{\log d\,\log\log d}))`$ for every sufficiently large d. We also prove a constant-distortion binary conversion for one prescribed input length. Together with the companion upper embedding theorem, these lower bounds determine the order of logarithmic distortion uniformly over finite alphabets with at least two symbols.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 平面库仑重整能的三角最优性
items.explanation_zh: 比较不同粒子排列的重整化能量。
items.source_title: Triangular minimality for planar Coulomb renormalized energy
items.source_abstract: We prove the Sandier–Serfaty conjecture: the triangular lattice of covolume one minimizes planar Coulomb renormalized energy over all admissible curl-free fields with a unit uniform background. Combined with Bétermin and Sandier's asymptotic formula, this also proves the Brauchart–Hardin–Saff conjecture for the linear term of optimal ordered-pair logarithmic energy on the unit two-sphere. The proof uses a direct Voronoi-cell comparison with rigorous interval arithmetic.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 不同整数斜率的三重遍历平均
items.explanation_zh: 研究混合变换多时刻平均的逐点极限。
items.source_title: Triple ergodic averages with distinct integer slopes
items.source_abstract: For every invertible mixing probability-preserving transformation, triple ergodic averages of bounded measurable functions along any three pairwise distinct nonzero integer slopes converge almost everywhere to the product of their integrals. The slopes may be positive or negative.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 随机轮流平均收益博弈
items.explanation_zh: 用确定性拟多项式算法计算长期收益策略。
items.source_title: Turn-Based Stochastic Mean-Payoff Games in Deterministic Quasipolynomial Time
items.source_abstract: We give a uniform deterministic quasipolynomial-time algorithm for finite turn-based stochastic mean-payoff games with signed integer rewards and rational chance-transition probabilities encoded in binary. It computes exactly the vertices of nonnegative value, including value zero, for the expectation of the pathwise liminf mean payoff. The algorithm uses exact rational arithmetic and $`2^{O((\log(L+2))^2)}`$ bit operations, where L is the complete binary input length.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 特殊拟射影空间的两步单值性
items.explanation_zh: 研究基本群的复线性表示。
items.source_title: Two-step monodromy of special quasi-projective varieties
items.source_abstract: We give an independent proof that every complex linear representation of the ordinary fundamental group of a connected smooth special complex quasi-projective variety has virtually nilpotent image of class at most two. This conclusion was previously announced by Cao–Deng–Hacon–Păun. We also construct special open surfaces whose general quasi-Albanese fibres are not special.
