items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 超平坦实 Littlewood 多项式
items.explanation_zh: 研究正负一系数多项式的近恒定圆周振幅。
items.source_title: Ultraflat real Littlewood polynomials
items.source_abstract: For every $`\varepsilon\in(0,1)`$ and every sufficiently large integer N, there is a polynomial of length N with coefficients in $`\{-1,1\}`$ whose modulus lies between $`(1-\varepsilon)\sqrt N`$ and $`(1+\varepsilon)\sqrt N`$ everywhere on the unit circle. Thus real Littlewood polynomials can be ultraflat through every sufficiently large integer length. The signs may be chosen separately at each length.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 平方根次数界的无界反例
items.explanation_zh: 比较布尔函数次数与影响量的增长。
items.source_title: Unbounded Violations of the Square-Root Degree Bound
items.source_abstract:
We disprove the Gopalan–Servedio square-root conjecture, even up to an arbitrary constant factor. For every real C > 0, there is a nonconstant Boolean function $`f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}`$ on a finite sign cube such that

$`\displaystyle \sum_{i=1}^n \widehat f(\{i\})\gt C\sqrt{\deg(f)}.`$

Here $`\widehat f(\{i\})`$ is the linear Fourier coefficient associated with the ith input, and $`\deg(f)`$ is the degree of the real multilinear polynomial representing f.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Weisfeiler–Leman 等价的时间下界
items.explanation_zh: 研究图细化等价判定的无条件复杂度。
items.source_title: Unconditional time lower bounds for Weisfeiler–Leman equivalence
items.source_abstract: For every sufficiently large fixed k, deciding whether two n-vertex graphs are k-Weisfeiler–Leman equivalent requires $`n^{\Omega(k)}`$ deterministic sequential time in the worst case. The bound holds at every sufficiently large graph order, even for simple connected uncolored graphs of diameter at most two, without a complexity assumption. Inputs are explicit adjacency matrices; the models are multitape Turing machines and sequential logarithmic-word RAMs with fixed polynomial-bit-time instructions. Both joint and separate replacement conventions are covered.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 弱 MTW 下的双 Hölder 输运
items.explanation_zh: 研究最优输运映射与逆映射的统一正则性。
items.source_title: Uniform Bi-Holder Transport from Weak MTW
items.source_abstract: We prove that the weak Ma–Trudinger–Wang condition on a fixed smooth connected compact boundaryless Riemannian manifold of dimension at least two implies a common Hölder estimate for optimal transport maps and their inverses over the entire class of probability densities with fixed positive upper and lower bounds. The maps have homeomorphic representatives, conjugate cut points are allowed, and no density regularity is assumed.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Fano 型收缩的统一 Cartier 截面
items.explanation_zh: 研究受控边界下除子截面的有效性。
items.source_title: Uniform Cartier sections for Fano type contractions
items.source_abstract: We prove the Cartier-divisor conjecture of Birkar and Shokurov for rational boundaries in characteristic zero and for real boundaries over ℂ. For an ϵ-lc Fano type contraction with positive-dimensional base and nef negative log canonical class, a Cartier divisor through any prescribed base point can be chosen with pullback log canonical threshold bounded below in terms of the dimension and ϵ alone.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: ∞-调和函数的内部梯度界
items.explanation_zh: 研究梯度的统一 Hölder 连续性。
items.source_title: Uniform Interior $`C^{1,\alpha}`$ Estimates for Infinity-Harmonic Functions
items.source_abstract: We prove a uniform interior $`C^{1,\alpha_d}`$ estimate for bounded infinity-harmonic functions in every dimension d ≥ 3. For some $`\alpha_d\in(0,1/3]`$ depending only on the dimension, the gradient's supremum norm and αd-Hölder seminorm on B1/2 are bounded by a dimension-dependent constant times the oscillation on B1. The exponent is not explicit, and no endpoint or boundary regularity claim is made. In particular, infinity-harmonic functions are locally C1 on every open subset of ℝd, for d ≥ 3.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 正特征的统一矩阵检测点
items.explanation_zh: 用一个矩阵替换检测所有受限非交换公式。
items.source_title: Uniform Matrix Hitting Points in Every Positive Characteristic
items.source_abstract: We construct a single matrix substitution that detects every nonzero size-s division-free noncommutative formula in n variables over every field of a given positive characteristic. One deterministic machine, given a promised prime p in binary and n, s in unary, outputs matrices over 𝔽p of dimension $`O(n^3s^6)`$ in polynomial bit time. The same tuple works with arbitrary extension-field coefficients, including in characteristic two. The construction also applies to the stated acyclic algebraic path programs.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 弱可逆质量作用系统的永久性
items.explanation_zh: 研究反应网络长期是否远离边界与无穷。
items.source_title: Uniform Permanence in Weakly Reversible Mass-Action Systems
items.source_abstract: We prove the permanence conjecture for finite weakly reversible mass-action systems with fixed positive reaction rates. Every positive stoichiometric compatibility class admits one compact convex forward-invariant set that every positive trajectory in that class enters in finite time, even when the class is unbounded. The set depends only on the network, the rates, and the class; the entry time may depend on the initial state. Thus, after its entry time, every concentration satisfies the same positive lower and finite upper bounds throughout that class.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 统一多典范 Iitaka 纤维化
items.explanation_zh: 研究固定维数下统一次数定义的纤维化。
items.source_title: Uniform Pluricanonical Iitaka Fibrations
items.source_abstract: We prove the effective Iitaka fibration conjecture in characteristic zero. For each dimension, one pluricanonical degree defines the Iitaka fibration of every smooth integral projective variety of that dimension and nonnegative Kodaira dimension over an algebraically closed field. The associated sections generate the full Iitaka function field.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 球面 Laughlin 能隙的稳定性
items.explanation_zh: 研究扰动后量子霍尔基态与能隙是否保持。
items.source_title: Uniform Stability of the Spherical Laughlin Gap
items.source_abstract: We prove that the fermionic Laughlin V1 Hamiltonian at filling 1/3 on expanding round spheres retains a unique ground state and a uniform spectral gap under sufficiently weak bounded real scalar one-body potentials projected to the lowest Landau level. With coefficient one for each pair projector and Laughlin flux $`q=3(N-1)`$, the gap and perturbation threshold are uniform for all sufficiently large particle numbers and all potential profiles of supremum norm at most one. The result uses the uniform unperturbed Fock-space gap and gives existential constants.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 随机 k-服务器界的统一计算
items.explanation_zh: 构造有限有理距离上的在线服务算法。
items.source_title: Uniform computation of the squared-logarithmic k-server bound
items.source_abstract: We construct a uniform randomized k-server algorithm on finite rational metrics with competitive ratio $`O(\log^2(k+1))`$ against oblivious request sequences. Preprocessing is polynomial in the input length, and per-request bit complexity is polynomial in that length and the binary request-counter length. The additive movement constant is finite and instance-dependent, but may be enormous. The construction uses the companion squared-logarithmic existence theorem.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 四维有效对数 Iitaka 纤维化
items.explanation_zh: 研究有限有理系数下统一纤维化次数。
items.source_title: Uniform effective log Iitaka fibrations for fourfolds
items.source_abstract: We prove the finite-rational-coefficient case of the effective log Iitaka conjecture in dimension four. For normal projective log canonical complex fourfolds with boundary coefficients in a fixed finite rational set and pseudo-effective rational Cartier adjoint, one uniform degree makes the complete rounded reflexive system nonempty and its section ratios generate the full Iitaka field. We also prove a uniform canonical index bound for projective klt complex fourfolds with rationally trivial canonical divisor.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 库仑分子的过剩电荷
items.explanation_zh: 估计分子可束缚电子数与中性原子外半径。
items.source_title: Uniform excess charge for Coulomb molecules and the outer radius of neutral atoms
items.source_abstract: We prove that a molecule with M fixed nuclei of real charges at least one and total nuclear charge Z strictly binds at most $`Z+CM`$ electrons, where C is universal. The result holds for the full nonrelativistic Coulomb Hamiltonian with two spin states and arbitrary distinct nuclear positions. For neutral atoms with integer nuclear charge Z ≥ 1, the first ionization energy and, for every ground state, the radius outside which one half of an electron remains are each bounded above and below by positive universal constants.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Landau–Siegel 零点的统一排除
items.explanation_zh: 研究实 L 函数靠近一的特殊零点。
items.source_title: Uniform exclusion of Landau–Siegel zeros
items.source_abstract: We prove the uniform exclusion of Landau–Siegel zeros. There is an absolute constant c > 0 such that every real zero $`\beta\in(0,1)`$ of every primitive nonprincipal real Dirichlet L-function of conductor q ≥ 3 satisfies $`(1-\beta)\log q\ge c`$.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 半对数典范 Calabi–Yau 的统一指数
items.explanation_zh: 研究固定维数与系数条件下典范类的阶数。
items.source_title: Uniform indices for semi-log-canonical log Calabi–Yau pairs
items.source_abstract: We prove a uniform index theorem for connected projective semi-log-canonical log Calabi–Yau pairs in every fixed dimension at least four over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. For boundary coefficients in a fixed finite rational set, a single multiple of the log canonical divisor is Cartier and linearly trivial. The multiple depends only on the dimension and coefficient set, not on the number of irreducible components. Together with the established theorem in dimensions at most three, this resolves the finite-rational-coefficient semi-log-canonical index conjecture.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 统一对数纤维化与模分母
items.explanation_zh: 控制高维对数 Iitaka 纤维化的有效次数。
items.source_title: Uniform log Iitaka fibrations and bounded moduli denominators
items.source_abstract: For normal projective log canonical pairs over algebraically closed fields of characteristic zero, of fixed dimension d ≥ 5 and with effective boundary coefficients in a fixed finite rational set, we prove that one complete rounded pluricanonical system generates the full Iitaka field whenever the ℚ-Cartier log canonical divisor has nonnegative Kodaira dimension. Its degree depends only on the dimension and coefficient set. For the paper's normalized canonical bundle formulae over ℂ, we also bound the Cartier denominators of the moduli divisors on smooth projective determining models in terms of the dimension and coefficient set.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 蜂窝带标记多边形的统一估计
items.explanation_zh: 研究两个标记点下的桥长度矩。
items.source_title: Uniform marked-polygon estimates and sharp finite bridge moments
items.source_abstract: We prove a uniform bound for critical honeycomb polygons through two axial marks on a periodic staircase. The bound retains an explicit power of the ratio between the period and the marked separation. We also prove sharp finite strip estimates: bridge mass of order h−1/4, first-length mass at most $`Ch^{13/12}`$, and mass at least $`ch^{-1/4}`$ on bridges with length at least $`ch^{4/3}`$.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 删除轨迹的统一重建算法
items.explanation_zh: 从随机删字符样本恢复任意二进制字符串。
items.source_title: Uniform quasipolynomial-time trace reconstruction
items.source_abstract: We give a uniform algorithm that reconstructs every binary string from independent deletion traces when its length and rational retention probability are known. For each fixed retention probability, both the number of traces and the bit complexity are quasipolynomial in the string length. More generally, we give an explicit sample bound uniform over all rational retention probabilities, with running time polynomial in the sample budget and the binary input length. If the deletion probability is at most $`n^{-\varepsilon}`$ for fixed ε > 0, the sample and running-time bounds are polynomial. Reconstruction succeeds with probability at least 2/3 for each input string.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 三角格点的实 Lipschitz 曲面
items.explanation_zh: 研究随机实高度的高斯自由场与 SLE₄ 极限。
items.source_title: Uniform real Lipschitz surfaces on the triangular lattice
items.source_abstract: We prove the Gaussian free field and SLE$`_4`$ scaling limits for uniformly sampled real nearest-neighbor Lipschitz heights on the triangular lattice, resolving Schramm's Problem 2.3. On approximations of smooth simply connected domains, the centered height field converges as a random distribution to a multiple of the Dirichlet Gaussian free field. At one tuned two-arc boundary amplitude, the zero-height interface converges in uniform curve distance to chordal SLE$`_4`$. We identify the relation between the field variance and the boundary height in terms of an implicit stationary tangent-flux coefficient.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 正双截曲率 Kähler 流形的统一化
items.explanation_zh: 研究完整非紧复空间的全纯几何类型。
items.source_title: Uniformization of complete Kähler manifolds with positive bisectional curvature
items.source_abstract: We prove that every complete connected noncompact Kähler manifold with strictly positive holomorphic bisectional curvature is biholomorphic to complex Euclidean space. This resolves Yau's uniformization conjecture positively in every complex dimension.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 可酉化与离散群可和性
items.explanation_zh: 研究一致有界表示能否变成酉表示。
items.source_title: Unitarizability implies amenability for discrete groups
items.source_abstract: We prove that a discrete group is amenable if and only if every uniformly bounded representation on a complex Hilbert space is similar to a unitary representation. This resolves Dixmier's unitarizability problem affirmatively for discrete groups.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 最终静止外力下的通用计算
items.explanation_zh: 用 Navier–Stokes 粒子实现最终稳定的计算外力。
items.source_title: Universal Computation with Eventually Stationary Navier–Stokes Forcing
items.source_abstract: At every fixed positive computable viscosity, we construct smooth mean-zero forces on the flat three-torus that become stationary after time one and make a fixed particle, initially in a fluid at rest, enter a fixed open set exactly when a prescribed Turing machine halts. The force has bounded derivatives of every order and a finite effective description. A reversible recording table is realized on whole planar rectangles by Hamiltonian motions, then driven by a mean-zero spatial clock. Separate choices give periodic forcing from time zero or a force whose derivatives are square-integrable in time.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 对称群的通用张量平方
items.explanation_zh: 研究包含所有不可约表示的张量平方。
items.source_title: Universal Tensor Squares for Symmetric Groups
items.source_abstract: For every positive integer n other than 2, 4, and 9, we prove that some irreducible complex representation of Sn has a tensor square containing every irreducible representation. This resolves the tensor square conjecture for symmetric groups affirmatively.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 紧 Kähler 流形万有覆盖的分裂
items.explanation_zh: 研究切丛分解是否对应覆盖空间的乘积分解。
items.source_title: Universal-cover splitting for compact Kähler manifolds
items.source_abstract: We prove the two-summand form of Beauville's compatible splitting conjecture. If the tangent bundle of a compact connected Kähler manifold decomposes into two integrable holomorphic subbundles of positive rank, then its ordinary universal cover admits a product decomposition whose factor tangent bundles are the lifted specified summands.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 三角格点的普遍能量最优性
items.explanation_zh: 比较平面粒子构型在多种势函数下的能量。
items.source_title: Universal optimality of the triangular lattice
items.source_abstract: We prove universal energy minimality for the triangular lattice in the plane. Among locally finite configurations of centered density one, it minimizes the lower limit of centered-ball energy averages for every nonnegative completely monotone function of squared distance, including when the energy is infinite. We also prove triangular minimality for planar logarithmic and Riesz renormalized energies, with $`0\lt s\lt 2`$ in the Riesz case, and the corresponding jellium minima. The proof uses sharp Gaussian Fourier bounds, positive mixtures, and heat-kernel comparison.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 强 Kadison–Kastler 稳定性
items.explanation_zh: 研究接近的冯诺依曼代数之间的小酉共轭。
items.source_title: Universal strong Kadison–Kastler stability
items.source_abstract: We prove that sufficiently close unital von Neumann algebras are conjugate by a unitary arbitrarily close to the identity. The tolerance depends only on the prescribed distance of that unitary from the identity, uniformly over all algebras, representations, and Hilbert spaces. This resolves the strong Kadison–Kastler conjecture.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 临界 SK 淬火自关联的普适性
items.explanation_zh: 研究平稳与淬火关联的联合函数极限。
items.source_title: Universality of critical quench autocorrelations in the Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model
items.source_abstract: We prove joint functional convergence of the stationary and quench autocorrelations of zero-field Sherrington–Kirkpatrick heat-bath dynamics at inverse temperature β = 1, with the same random limit for Gaussian and Rademacher couplings. Each site has a rate-one clock, mean spin autocorrelations are multiplied by n1/3, and waiting times and lags are measured in units n2/3. The quench starts from independent fair spins, and convergence is uniform on compact sets of positive waiting times and lags. The quench limit is selected by these initial states and relaxes to the stationary limiting autocorrelation as the waiting time tends to infinity.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 素数二处的无约束 pro-模性
items.explanation_zh: 研究二维 2 进 Galois 表示的模性。
items.source_title: Unrestricted pro-modularity at the prime two
items.source_abstract: Every continuous, odd, absolutely irreducible two-dimensional 2-adic representation of $`G_{\mathbb Q}`$ that is unramified outside finitely many finite primes occurs in the full completed Hecke algebra at some odd tame level. The level may contain auxiliary tame primes, and scalar and reducible residual representations are included. This is a completed-Hecke occurrence result, with no de Rham hypothesis; it does not assert classical modularity.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 高阶有界 Hochschild 上同调的消失
items.explanation_zh: 研究冯诺依曼代数中高阶余循环是否为边界。
items.source_title: Vanishing of higher bounded Hochschild cohomology
items.source_abstract: We prove that every bounded Hochschild cocycle of degree at least two on a complex von Neumann algebra, with values in the algebra itself, has a bounded primitive. Together with the established degree-one inner-derivation theorem, this resolves the Kadison–Ringrose cohomology conjecture positively.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 可变维 Weisfeiler–Leman 等价
items.explanation_zh: 研究一般图和次三次图上的判定复杂度。
items.source_title: Variable-dimension Weisfeiler–Leman equivalence on general and subcubic graphs
items.source_abstract: Deciding joint-update k-dimensional Weisfeiler–Leman equivalence is $`\mathsf{EXPTIME}`$-complete when the two graphs are given by explicit adjacency matrices and k ≥ 2 is encoded in binary. The result holds even for connected simple uncolored graphs of equal positive order and maximum degree at most three.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 随机 k-SAT 停时的方差
items.explanation_zh: 估计随机公式首次不可满足时刻的涨落。
items.source_title: Variance of the Random k-SAT Hitting Time
items.source_abstract: Let Hn be the index of the first unsatisfiable prefix in random k-SAT on n variables, with independent uniformly signed clauses using k distinct variables and sampled with replacement. For every fixed k ≥ 4, we prove $`\mathop{\mathrm{Var}}\nolimits (H_n)=\Theta_k(n)`$. For k = 3, the variance is bounded below by a positive multiple of n and above by a constant multiple of $`n\log n`$; the companion paper on random 3-SAT sharpens this to $`\Theta(n)`$. The same upper bounds proved here hold after clipping at any fixed positive multiple of n.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 由速度场检测流体计算
items.explanation_zh: 研究受外力流体速度如何反映计算状态。
items.source_title: Velocity-Field Detection of Computation in Forced Navier–Stokes Flows
items.source_abstract: We construct smooth forces for three-dimensional incompressible Navier–Stokes flow, from rest at any fixed positive computable viscosity, whose velocity field detects whether a prescribed machine halts. On the unit flat torus, a pointwise test of the third velocity component uses successively shorter stirring intervals in a fixed spatial region. On $`\mathbb R^2\times\mathbb T`$, an integral test uses an expanding array of translation regions and a force with globally bounded mixed derivatives. The vertical velocity solves an advection–diffusion equation: short bursts control its pointwise error in the first construction, and a moving cutoff controls the total escaped mass in the second.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 射影完全交的 Virasoro 约束
items.explanation_zh: 研究 Gromov–Witten 后裔不变量的对称约束。
items.source_title: Virasoro Constraints for Projective Complete Intersections
items.source_abstract: We prove the Virasoro conjecture for the ordinary descendant Gromov–Witten theory of smooth complete intersections in projective space, in every genus and curve class and with arbitrary cohomology insertions. This includes primitive and odd cohomology classes, with no semisimplicity assumption.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 射影化下的 Virasoro 约束
items.explanation_zh: 研究向量丛射影化如何传递枚举几何关系。
items.source_title: Virasoro Constraints under Projectivization
items.source_abstract: We prove that full ordinary descendant Virasoro constraints pass from a smooth projective complex base to the projectivization of any algebraic vector bundle of rank at least two. The bundle need not split and satisfies no positivity requirement. Assuming the full constraints on the base, the conclusion includes every genus, each individual integral curve class, and all cohomology insertions, including primitive and odd classes. The result also applies successively to towers of projective bundles.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 双曲单关系群的虚紧特殊性
items.explanation_zh: 研究群能否通过有限覆盖获得特殊立方结构。
items.source_title: Virtual compact specialness of hyperbolic one-relator groups
items.source_abstract: We prove that every word-hyperbolic one-relator group is virtually compact special. Combined with the work of Kielak–Linton, this resolves Wise's virtual free-by-cyclic conjecture for hyperbolic one-relator groups: every such group is virtually free-by-cyclic, with the free kernel allowed to have infinite rank.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: RCD 空间每条测地线的弱 Hessian 界
items.explanation_zh: 研究非光滑曲率空间中的二阶微分控制。
items.source_title: Weak Hessian bounds along every geodesic in RCD spaces
items.source_abstract: On a full-support $`\mathrm{RCD}(K,N)`$ space with $`1\lt N\lt \infty`$, we prove that a bounded globally Lipschitz function whose distributional Hessian is bounded above by a bounded continuous function satisfies the corresponding second-derivative inequality along every minimizing geodesic.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 纯类型系统的弱与强正规化
items.explanation_zh: 研究存在终止化简是否保证所有化简终止。
items.source_title: Weak and strong normalization in pure type systems
items.source_abstract: We prove that every weakly β-normalizing pure type system is strongly β-normalizing. Both properties quantify over all legal expressions in all valid contexts, and reduction acts inside type annotations. No functionality hypothesis is required. This resolves the β-Barendregt–Geuvers–Klop conjecture.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 无理角三角台球的弱混合
items.explanation_zh: 研究轨道相关性随时间的消失。
items.source_title: Weak mixing of triangular billiards with an irrational angle
items.source_abstract: We prove that the unit-speed billiard flow in every nondegenerate Euclidean triangle with at least one angle irrational relative to π is weakly mixing for normalized Liouville measure. Equivalently, the product of the flow with itself is ergodic.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 弱纯无限性与 O∞ 吸收
items.explanation_zh: 研究算子代数中无限性和稳定吸收的关系。
items.source_title: Weak pure infiniteness and O-infinity absorption
items.source_abstract: We prove that every complex C∗-algebra in which each positive element is properly infinite is strongly purely infinite. This answers the ordinary-to-strong part of Kirchberg–Rørdam's comparison question. For exact algebras, we also prove that proper infiniteness of one fixed finite amplification of every positive element implies proper infiniteness of each positive element. Consequently, every separable nuclear algebra with this fixed-amplification property absorbs $`\mathcal O_\infty`$, without assumptions of unitality or simplicity.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 欧拉函数纤维的大小
items.explanation_zh: 研究多少不同整数能具有同一个欧拉函数值。
items.source_title: Weighted dilation graphs, smooth shifted primes and totient fibers
items.source_abstract: We prove Erdős's conjecture on the largest fibers of Euler's totient function: for every ε > 0, infinitely many positive integers n have more than $`n^{1-\varepsilon }`$ preimages. We also show that, for every fixed δ > 0, there are at least $`x^{1-o(1)}`$ primes p in $`2x\lt p\le5x`$ whose predecessors have no prime factor exceeding xδ.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 阿贝尔幂中的 Weil 与 Hodge 类
items.explanation_zh: 研究六维阿贝尔簇自乘积的代数上同调类。
items.source_title: Weil classes and Hodge classes on abelian powers
items.source_abstract: We prove the rational Hodge conjecture in every codimension on every self-power of a complex abelian sixfold with an imaginary-quadratic action and a compatible polarization whose rational homological Hermitian form is hyperbolic of signature $`(3,3)`$. We also prove it in every codimension on every self-power of a complex abelian variety of dimension at most five admitting an imaginary-quadratic action. Both results include nonsimple varieties and special periods with additional endomorphisms. The proof uses the companion theorem on the rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 见证对称选择的表达能力
items.explanation_zh: 比较带见证选择与带计数无选择计算。
items.source_title: Witnessed symmetric choice is strictly stronger than choiceless polynomial time with counting
items.source_abstract: We prove that witnessed symmetric choice strictly increases the expressive power of choiceless polynomial time with counting. A fixed sentence with one witnessed-choice occurrence defines a Boolean query on every finite input that is not definable in the original counting formalism.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: Einstein 四维空间的零平面刚性
items.explanation_zh: 研究零截曲率平面对整体几何的限制。
items.source_title: Zero-Plane Rigidity for Einstein Four-Manifolds
items.source_abstract: We prove that a closed Einstein four-manifold with positive Einstein constant, nonnegative sectional curvature, and a zero-curvature plane has universal Riemannian cover isometric to a product of two round two-spheres. Under the normalization $`\mathop{\mathrm{Ric}}\nolimits =3g`$, both spheres have radius $`1/\sqrt3`$. The proof extends coupled estimates for the two Weyl curvature blocks to the boundary of the sectional-curvature cone and determines their equality case.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 非剩余有限的无挠双曲群
items.explanation_zh: 构造无法由有限群分离所有元素的双曲群。
items.source_title: A torsion-free hyperbolic group that is not residually finite
items.source_abstract: We construct a torsion-free word-hyperbolic group that is not residually finite, answering the residual-finiteness question for hyperbolic groups negatively.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 丰沛二阶丛的正度量障碍
items.explanation_zh: 研究二次曲面上的 Griffiths 正度量。
items.source_title: Ample rank-two bundles on the quadric surface without Griffiths-positive metrics
items.source_abstract: We give counterexamples to Griffiths' conjecture in rank two on the quadric surface $`\mathbb P^1\times\mathbb P^1`$. We construct an explicit bundle G whose coordinatewise power pullbacks, tensored with $`\mathcal O(1,1)`$, are ample for every positive power, but admit no smooth strictly Griffiths-positive Hermitian metric for all sufficiently large powers.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 轨迹重建的定量下界
items.explanation_zh: 估计从随机删除样本恢复字符串所需次数。
items.source_title: Quantitative lower bounds for trace reconstruction
items.source_abstract: Exact worst-case reconstruction of a binary word from independent deletion traces requires $`n^{\Omega(\log\log n)}`$ samples for every fixed deletion probability $`q\in(0,1)`$, even with unrestricted computation and any fixed positive success probability. This gives a negative answer to the polynomial-sample question for binary trace reconstruction. More generally, when $`q^3\log n\to\infty`$, we prove a lower bound of $`n^{c\log(q^3\log n)}`$ samples for every fixed $`0\lt c\lt 1/(4\log2)`$. Here q is the known deletion probability, and all logarithms are natural.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 虚多循环群的拟等距识别
items.explanation_zh: 研究大尺度距离结构是否决定群的类型。
items.source_title: Quasi-isometric recognition of virtually polycyclic groups
items.source_abstract: We prove that every finitely generated group quasi-isometric to a finitely generated virtually polycyclic group is virtually polycyclic. This resolves the lattice-recognition conjecture of Eskin, Fisher and Whyte, which allows the ambient solvable Lie group in the conclusion to differ from the one in the hypothesis.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 素数的加法不可分解性
items.explanation_zh: 研究素数集合能否分解为两个非平凡集合的和。
items.source_title: The additive indecomposability of the primes
items.source_abstract: We prove Ostmann's inverse Goldbach conjecture: no set differing from the primes by finitely many elements can be written as $`A+B`$, where A and B are sets of nonnegative integers with at least two elements each.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 五次 Liénard 系统的极限环
items.explanation_zh: 限制经典五次平面系统的周期轨道数量。
items.source_title: Two limit cycles for quintic Liénard systems
items.source_abstract: Every classical Liénard system $`\dot x=y-F(x)`$, $`\dot y=-x`$, with F an arbitrary real polynomial of degree at most five, has at most two geometrically distinct isolated periodic orbits, and the bound is attained. This proves the degree-five case of the Lins Neto–de Melo–Pugh conjecture.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results

items.topic_zh: 平面多项式极限环的统一界
items.explanation_zh: 限制指定次数系统中的孤立周期轨道数。
items.source_title: Uniform bounds for planar polynomial limit cycles
items.source_abstract: For every degree, we prove that the number of isolated periodic orbits of a real planar polynomial vector field is bounded by a finite constant depending only on that degree. This establishes the uniform boundedness assertion in the second part of Hilbert's sixteenth problem. The proof uses separation of asymptotic expansions on nested complex domains and a finite-dimensional counting argument.
items.interpretation: short editorial paraphrase of title and abstract; not independent confirmation of claimed results
